hound of cardiff moor.name: Hound of Cardiff Moor
hound of cardiff moor.origin: Murdock's unnamed hound was his personal pet. Angry that his family's former land had been taken over by other people and split into various properties, Murdock decided to his father's vow that his would destroy any who would come to live in Cardiff Moor to his advantage. He covered his hound in luminescent paint and sent it out to attack the moor's residents before dressing up in a hound costume and killing them. Murdock's actions caught the attention of Captain America and Bucky who stationed in nearby Camp Lehigh. They went to Cardiff to investigate. After Murdock failed to scare the two heroes off, he joined them and some of the Moor's other residents in a search for the ghost hound. Murdock eventually broke off from the ground and sent out his hound to kill everyone while he dressed up in his hound costume. After Murdock and his hound killed a writer named Ramon, they went after Murdock's neighbor Mary Scott. Mary was rescued by Captain America who killed the hound by snapping its neck and defeating Murdock in a fight. Murdock was then unmasked, and his scheme uncovered.

house killer.name: House Killer
house killer.origin: The man known as the House Killer was a criminal who was active in the 1940s. In 1946 he learned that a boarded up house owned by John Kirk in the area was once used for making gold plating and that the house's structure was loaded with hold dust that could be extracted to make a fortune. This was learned at the time when there was currently a housing crisis going on in New York City. When Kirk decided to repair the house to rent out to potential tenants, the crook developed the identity of the House Killer to distract the authorities from his real plan. The House Killer and his men removed the house from the property and replaced it with a hollow replica and lit it on fire. Then left a note that proclaimed the house was destroyed by someone angry at Kirk for refusing to rent a place out to them. The resulting explosion attracted the attention of the Human Torch and Toro. In order to further throw off the heroes investigation, the House Killer set up another fake house and set it to go off. However, he was interrupted, and even though the House Killer doused them in flame retarding chemicals he only succeeded in blowing the roof off his fake house, allowing the Torch and Toro to realize part of his scheme. The House Killer then went to the city records office to destroy the information on the Kirk house. They were once more opposed by the Human Torch and Toro, but they were once more knocked out and the House Killer succeeded in destroying most of the report on the Kirk house. However, part of the report survived tipping off the Torch as to what the House Killer's plan was. They managed to track them down to the chemical factory that they were using to extract the gold dust out of the housing materials and busted the crooks. Turned over to the authorities, the House Killer confessed his plans. His subsequent activities are unknown.

house of shadows.name: House of Shadows
house of shadows.species: An entity from another dimension that came to Earth
house of shadows.origin: The House of Shadows was an old cottage on the outskirts of New York City that was rumored to be haunted. When a TV reporter entered the house to investigate, he was swallowed by the mystical forces of the house. Doctor Strange ventured into the house to free the journalist and learned that the house was a visitor from a shadow world that bordered a pocket realm near Limbo, that came to Earth to observe humanity. Strange banished the house to its home dimension. The Galadorian Spaceknights were exiling their enemies, the Dire Wraiths, to the same Limbo, and when the remaining Wraiths tried to recover their imprisoned peers, they accidentally made the House of Shadows return to Earth, where it was encountered by Rom the Spaceknight, Steve Jackson, and Brandy Clark. While on the run from the forces of the Dire Wraiths, the trio entered an abandoned house, which then tried to carry off Steve and Brandy. Dr. Strange contacted ROM via a dream, and told ROM the true nature of the house. Using this knowledge, ROM used his Neutralizer to cast the entity to Limbo. Once more the entity made its way back to Earth, this time taking the shape of the top floor of a condominium. The disappearances of the building's residents caught the attention of Dr. Strange, who recognized the patterns of the entity. Strange used the opportunity to test his disciple Rintrah. Rintrah used the same methods as his teacher, and cast the entity back to its realm once again. The House of Shadows reappeared on Earth, taking the form of the top floor of an apartment building. When people started going missing, a neighbor went to Moon Knight for help. He ventured into the building's floor, but it eventually casted him out after an attempt to connect with Moon Knight's fractured mind caused it agony. After seeking help from Wong, Moon Knight learned about the floor's true nature as the House of Shadows. Finding compassion for the House, Moon Knight offered to help it fulfill its desire to be lived in. The House of Shadows then took over the ruins of the offices of Moon Knight's Midnight Mission, refurbishing Moon Knight's base of operations and becoming it. The House of Shadows protected Reese and Soldier while Zodiac was coming for them, but they left its protection when their neighbors were threatened. Resuming functions as an office space, the House of Shadows utilized its magical spaces to psychologically punish Nemean and Grand Mal. After Moon Knight's death stopping the Black Spectre, the Shroud took up his identity. He tried to claim the Mission as his headquarters, but the living building violently rejected him. During the Blood Hunt, the Midnight Mission acted as a shelter for civilians. The Midnight Mission began going after Achilles Fairchild's criminal gang, causing the criminal mastermind to organize a plan to take them down. In preparation for the NYPD storming the Midnight Mission, Fairchild sent his agent by the name of Carver to prevent the House of Shadows from helping them. She went to the top of the building where she proceeded to stab it with her magic sword, possessed by the spirit of the soul-hoarding dragon Ginnarr, which absorbed the House's soul, seemingly killing it. The Midnight Mission was able to regroup and defeat Fairchild and his forces, with Moon Knight claiming Ginnarr as his own weapon. After their defeat, the Midnight Mission through a joint celebration of their victory and a birthday party for Moon Knight himself in order to reiterate to the people of New York that the Mission was still with them. During this celebration Moon Knight, realizing that if the Hoarding Blade could steal and hold the House's soul he could also be forced to return it, went to the rooftop and plunged the blade in, demanding the House's soul return to it. With Ginnarr now bound to Marc and Khonshu's will, he complied, and the return of its soul caused the House of Shadows to return to life once more.

howard avery.name: Howard Avery
howard avery.species: Human mutate; turned into a monster through an experiment.
howard avery.origin: Dr. Howard Avery was a skinny scientist who wanted to bulk up by taking a formula of his own creation. In the case of Avery, it made him into a gigantic furry monster which was nicknamed the Brute That Walks which went on a rampage. Once cured, Howard Avery gave up the formula and went back to his normal life. howard duckson.name: Howard Duckson
howard duckson.origin: ===Early Life=== Howard the Duck was hatched on Duckworld, an alternate Earth in an alternate universe where intelligent life evolved from ducks. Duckworld resembles mankind's Earth in an astounding number of ways, including the fact that ducks speak English. He was the son of Ronald and Henrietta, a working class Roman Catholic couple living in New Stork. He had two siblings, his sister, Theresa and his brother, Orville. As a child, he discovered an amazing potential intellect; however, he was continuously bullied by other children as a result. He eventually decided to give up on his studies, completely wasting his potential. Further details about Howard's past on Duckworld are still unknown. Indeed, there are conflicting accounts as to the circumstances surrounding his disappearance. ===Arrival on Earth=== Howard vanished from his homeworld when the power-hungry Hell-Lord Thog the Nether-Spawn used his demonic powers to cause the interdimensional Cosmic Axis to shift. Howard was dislodged from his home dimension and dropped into the middle of the Florida Everglades on Earth-616 at the Man-Thing's Swamp, the site of this world's Nexus of All Realities, a place from which travel to all other dimensions is said to be possible. In an effort to set the Cosmic Axis right and return home, the reluctant Howard joined up with Korrek of Ktharta, who also came from another dimension, the young Earth-born sorceress Jennifer Kale, the wizard Dakimh the Enchanter, and the Man-Thing, the guardian of the Nexus. The battle against Thog ended for Howard when he fell from the other-dimensional Stepping Stones of Oblivion. ===Cleveland and Garko, the Man-Frog=== He landed back on Earth-616 in the city of Cleveland, Ohio, where he first faced the menace of Garko, the Man-Frog. ===Bessie the Hellcow=== Howard the Duck wanted to establish a reputation in Cleveland. As such, he sought to earn a position in the Cleveland Police Department by catching this mysterious farm stalker. During the investigation, he found Bessie the Hellcow, who attacked him, but Howard kept her at bay with a makeshift cross. During the fight, he used a mallet and a wooden stake to seemingly end the blood-sucking bovine's Hellish existence once and for all. Despite his heroism, however, Howard was still denied a position on the Cleveland police force, much to his dismay. ===Meeting Beverly Switzler=== In Cleveland, Howard first met the young life model Beverly Switzler, who was a captive of the costumed criminal accountant Pro-Rata. Howard and Beverly escaped and began living together. Although Howard attempted to live as normal a life as he possibly could, considering that he was an anthropomorphic talking duck in a world of human beings, he continually ran afoul of various unusual menaces, including the Turnip Man, Count Macho, the Winky-Man, Emile "The Goat" Klout, and the Gingerbread Man. Howard came to public notoriety when he became a candidate for the United States Presidency on a very minor party ticket. He was even the target of an assassination plot, as someone had hired Doctor Angst and his group, the Band of the Bland, to kill him. Howard defeated his would-be assassins with the help of the Defenders and they were sent to prison. As it turned out, the assassination was unnecessary, as the general populace refused to believe that Howard was a real talking duck, thinking of him instead as a dwarf in a duck suit. As a result, the public dismissed his candidacy as a joke. He continued to battle villains such as the Bellhop, Le Beaver, Kong Lomerate, the Kidney Lady, the Rev. Joon Moon Yuc and his cult, the Yuccies, and Roxxon. ===Doctor Bong=== Howard's arch-enemy was Doctor Bong. Through cleverness, persistence, and just plain good (if not dumb) luck, he always managed to either defeat, or escape from, his adversaries. ===S.O.O.F.I.=== Howard went up against a hate group called S.O.O.F.I. (Save Our Offspring From Indecency) who were "trying to restore order to the world". ===Bzzk'joh=== While relaxing in his apartment, Howard was attacked by a salt shaker with arms and legs sitting on a giant housefly, but they were unable to defeat him. Dakimh the Enchanter and the Man-Thing arrived to ask Howard for his help and he was reluctantly transported to the Castle in the Sky over the Land Between Night and Day, where they were reunited with Korrek of Ktharta and Jennifer Kale, who were both surprised to discover that Howard was still alive after all this time. Dakimh brought all of them there to battle the demon Bzzk'joh. Bzzk'jho attacked them first and Jennifer was forced to use her power to bring to life NAAC-P30 and 2-2 2-2, two Druid Droids that helped Howard, Korrek, and the Man-Thing stop jho. When Howard still refused to help, Korrek threatened him. Howard conceded when he tried to use the gun that was given to him by Dakimh and it turned out to only shoot a comedic flag. Riding Dakimh's spaceship, the Epoch Weasel, into the universe to get to

fields.notes: Howard was originally from Earth-47920. But this reality later overlapped with Earth-791021/Duckworld, affecting Howard's memory, which is why he remembered tha latter as his home. In an unpublished script by Steve Gerber, it was revealed that on Howard's pre-warp homeworld, his parents were named Dave and Dottie instead of Ronald and Henrietta. Though the script remained unpublished, and Marvel official website listed Dave and Dottie as his parents without any explaination. It was later fully confirmed by the Marvel Appendix profiles for Duckworld-791021 and Duckworld-85197 that Dave and Dottie were indeed Howard's true parents. Howard was featured in both of the Marvel Swimsuit Special one-shots.
fields.trivia: As per , Howard possesses the ability to grow whiskers out of his bill. Howard's phone number is (555)-DUK-DICK. Doctor Strange cast a spell on Howard which makes his tail feathers grow longer every time that he calls Strange a jerk. Back in the 1970s, The Walt Disney Company threatened to sue Marvel Comics over Howard the Duck's similarities in design to . Marvel capitulated to Disney's demands, which included that they had to make Howard look like a design sheet that Disney supplied. The most notable difference was the inclusion of pants in the revised design. In which was written by Howard's creator, Steve Gerber, Howard was replaced by a duplicate in the mainstream Marvel Universe of Earth-616, and changed his name to Leonard the Duck. Gerber's intent was to "take back" his characters, but it was not acknowledged by either the company or the fans, and Gerber eventually killed off Leonard. However, Chip Zdarsky, the writer of , wrote the character as though he was the clone out of respect for the late Gerber. In the miniseries, Howard was merged with Deadpool to become Deadpool the Duck. Howard's full name was first revealed in . In the panel where this reveal was mentioned, a footnote by writer Chip Zdarsky urged all Marvel wikis to update themselves with this information. Before this retcon, originally his last name appears to have 5 or 6 letters, to start with a "P" (or "B" or "R") and end with a "K", as seen when he erased it from a paycheck. On Howard's "homeworld", the colloquial expression "hair of the dog" is replaced with "claw of the eagle".

howard mason.origin: The Skrull that adopted the identity of Howard Mason was an inhabitant of Kral X, a small colony part of the Kral System. The Kral System represented a peculiar portion of the Skrull Empire, a group of planets dedicated solely to the recreation of Earth's culture and media. In the case of Kral X, its prince used it to emulate the 50-year-old TV series The Ritchie Redwood Show, with Howard Mason being one of the characters of its cast, and the identity one of Kral X's Skrulls adopted. While strolling through a market in another planet, Mason discovered the MIA U.S.Avenger Cannonball being sold as a slave. Mason bought him and took him to Kral X so to have a real Earther to learn from.

When Medinnus told him he had to help them, Taskmaster responded that they would all be captured and imprisoned, while he would erase all records and data links and flee to Costa Salvador.

howard mitchell.name: Howard Mitchell
howard mitchell.origin: Howard Mitchell was the owner of an armored truck company, but was unsatisfied with his personal profits. He decided then to steal his own trucks. To do so, he created a costumed identity including independently developed technology. He used a knock-out, amnesia-inducing gas he learned about from a voyage to Peru, wearing a gas-mask to became the Hijacker. As the Hijacker was familiar with all of the secrets of Mitchell's company, he managed to perform four successful thefts. He never killed a witness, because witnesses could not identify him due to temporary amnesia. The police was unable to stop the Hijacker. Mitchell, feigning anger, demanded the help of a superhero: Ant-Man (Hank Pym). Mitchell felt that such a small hero could be no threat to him. The Ant-Man in turn understood that someone in the company was helping the Hijacker, or was the Hijacker himself. After seeing some Peruvian statues in Mitchell's office, he related them to the Peruvian gas used by the Hijacker and immediately suspected of Mitchell. Thus, the Ant-Man pretended to suffer from appendicitis and in secret hid in one of the trucks: In other case, the Hijacker would not attack. The Hijacker attacked the truck believing that he would not have to fight, but he met the Ant-Man, who was using a gas-proof mask of his own. Ant-Man fought the Hijacker, defeated him and revealed he knew it had been Mitchell all the time. Mitchell was then sent to jail. Mitchell eventually escaped or was freed, and decided to change his modus operandi: The Hijacker would steal technology and re-sell it in black market auctions. He tried to steal Anthony Stark's designs at Stark West, but he met with Black Goliath and the Thing, who were performing some tests. Hijacker understood he was no match for both of them together, so he escaped and returned with a new trick: His own armored tank. Nevertheless, in a fight, Black Goliath and the Thing destroyed the tank and captured the Hijacker. When the Hijacker tried to reveal his real name (probably thinking that cooperation would reduce his term), the Thing showed little interest on anything he could say. Months after that, the Hijacker discovered that the Thing was hospitalized due to injuries caused by Gladiator and the Champion of the Universe. It was a great chance for getting his revenge on him. Other villains had also thought about it, but in fact superheroes who were the Thing's friends had thought of that, and gathered in the hospital to protect him. Although the Hijacker used a new tank in the attack, it was destroyed by Iron Man, who also apprehended him. Free again through unknown means, the Hijacker was contacted by Gary Gilbert, a former customed criminal turned into business agent for criminals. Gilbert was worried about the Scourge of the Underworld, a masked figure who was killing customed criminals such as Gilbert and Mitchell. Gilbert organized a meeting in the Bar with No Name, Medina County, Ohio, to discuss potential counter-attacks. As the Scourge was known to use weapons instead of powers, weapons were to be left at the door, leaving Mitchell helpless. However, the Scourge infiltrated in the meeting disguised as the bartender and shot down all the seventeen criminals (including Mitchell) wielding a cut-down .50 submachine gun in each hand. After Spider-Island, Mitchell - resurrected by The Hood - decided to rob a bank with his truck, but was chased by Venom after he ran over a security guard. During the pursuit, Hijacker squashed a mother and his son, killing them. Enraged, Venom hid in Hijacker's truck and faced him in his hideout. He broke Hijacker's fingers, hit him many times and bit his head off before spitting it out.

howard nees.name: Howard Nees
howard nees.origin: Howard Nees used to be a C.P.A. in Miami until he fell in with the wrong crowd, in the process discovering an inner Howard Nees that was dying to come out. He moved to New York City, where he became the city's main peddler of synthetic heroin. Howard confronted the Kingpin at every turn and started a mob war by shooting at his dealers and killing innocent bystanders. The Kingpin had Microchip kidnapped and sent one of his fingers to the Punisher. He forced the Punisher to take out Howard Nees and shut down his operations, or receive more pieces of Microchip. The men that Howard sent to kill the Punisher were killed by claymore mines. Howard then led an attack on the Kingpin's trucking company but was ambushed enroute by the Punisher, who took out the attacking force and killed Howard.

howard ogden.name: Howard Ogden
howard ogden.origin: With Carnage on the loose and taking over Doverton, Colorado, the U.S. Armed Forces needed Symbiotes to combat the threat. After the Hybrid symbiote was de-fused, the Riot symbiote was assigned to Petty Officer Howard Ogden, who trained with it for months teaching it for specific tasks. Howard was part of the Mercury Team, a task force formed after the Venom debacle. He and the other human members of the Mercury Team were later killed by Carnage when the criminal by chance encountered their secret base located in Carrington Cottage during his murderous journey around the United States of America.

howard phillips.name: Howard Phillips
howard phillips.origin: Howard Phillips was a friend of Edmund Fiske and Robert Blake. After Blake died, Phillips and Fiske began investigating. Phillips met with Dr. Dexter, who admitted to believe the Shining Trapezohedron was tied to Blake's death. He stol and threw the jewel into the Narragansett Bay. Phillips kept on his investigations, reading old books and records, and seeking the full story of the shadow demon. He was found dead three days later, presumably killed by Nyarlathotep or his panthers.

fields.notes: In "The Shadow From the Steeple" (September, 1950) by Robert Bloch, this character was originally Howard Phillips Lovecraft himself. In the adaptation of that story in (June, 1973), Lovecraft was renamed Howard Phillips. This story was a sequel to "The Haunter of the Dark" (December, 1936) by H.P. Lovecraft, adapted in (April, 1973), and in which Robert Blake (based on Robert Bloch) was killed. It was itself a sequel of "The Shambler from the Stars" (September, 1935) by Robert Bloch, in which a reclusive scholar living in Providence, and based on Lovecraft, was killed. In the adaptation of that story in (February, 1973), the reclusive scholar was penciled by Jim Starlin in traits resembling H.P. Lovecraft. While this character is to be considered separated from Howard Phillips Lovecraft, Lovecraft is himself a character on his own in the Marvel Universe, being mentioned on occasion.

howard ryland.name: Howard Ryland
howard ryland.origin: Owner of the retail chain "Ryland Computers", which was harassed by the Demolisher who set afire his stores. The Demolisher turned out to be his chauffeur Charles that wanted revenge for not being recognized as the one who conceived the creation of the chain of computer stores that enriched Ryland.

howard saint.name: Howard Saint
howard saint.origin: Howard Saint was a ruthless mobster. After his son Bobby was killed by Frank Castle, Howard ordered the whole man's family to be killed in revenge. Thinking Castle had died in the attack, Saint was pleased. When the Toro brothers, a pair of Cuban mobsters, complain about a failed trade in Saint's territory, and a huge amount of money was lost, Howard realized that Castle was still alive and on a personal vendetta against him. He hired two assassins, Harry Heck and The Russian, to kill him. Meanwhile, Castle, with the aid of the criminal Micky Duka (who has his own reasons for hating the Saints), made Howard believe that his wife Livia was cheating on him with his best friend Quentin Glass (who is actually homosexual) with false evidence planted by Castle, found by Saint himself. Howard believed he has a confirmation of the two's affair when he finds Livia's earring on Quentin's pillow in his home (actually planted by Castle). After a confrontation, Howard killed Quentin, with the latter not knowing why. Later, he killed his wife Livia. He was then killed by Castle who reveals he planted the evidence and that he killed his wife and friend for nothing.

howard shelton.name: Howard Shelton
howard shelton.origin: thumb|left|200px Howard Shelton was a soldier in the 1940s. He met Zarda, ambassador from Utopia Isle, when she first ventured into the outside world and joined the Golden Agency as "Power Princess". The two married when they were both still young, but while Zarda remained young and vital as the decades passed, Howard aged naturally. Old and frail, Howard lived with his wife at Squadron City after the Utopia Program began. When an evil doppelganger of Hyperion infiltrated the Squadron, however, he decided he wanted Zarda for himself. Hyperion went to the Shelton's house one night and used his super-lungs to draw the air out of Howard's lungs, killing him in his sleep.

howard stacy.name: Howard Stacy
howard stacy.origin: Howard was one of the brothers of Gwen Stacy. He attended both her graduation and her funeral. One year after their father, Captain George Stacy of the N.Y.P.D., died attempting to assist Spider-Man and stop the Lizard during his bio-terrorist attack on New York City, Howard and the rest of his family were interviewed by Ned Leeds of the Daily Bugle. Ned asked the kids in the family what their classmates thought about that night, to which Howard's brother, Simon, said that while they all thought Spider-Man was cool, they thought his dad was the coolest.

howard stark.name: Howard Stark
howard stark.origin: ===Early Life=== Howard Stark was born and raised in Richford, New York as the son of Howard Stark Sr. He grew up there with his brother Edward and was a brilliant engineer and industrialist who co-inherited Stark Industries from his father. Edward later sold all the shares of his half of the inheritance to him as he did not want to be part of the family business unlike Howard. ===WWII=== During World War II, the Red Skull abducted Howard and his then-wife, and tortured him to gain information about the Manhattan Project. They were later rescued by Captain America and the Howling Commandos. thumb|left|250px|An agent of the Brotherhood of the Shield with Nathaniel Richards ===Brotherhood of the Shield=== In 1951, Howard Stark left his family to become an agent for a mysterious organization called the Brotherhood of the Shield, an ancient secret society of intellectuals led by Sir Isaac Newton. The group had protected the human race from threats for millennia. His first mission, with scientist Dr. Nathaniel Richards, was to track down the recently resurfaced Nikola Tesla and retrieve his forever machines, as well as Newton's superhuman son, Leonid. Richards killed Tesla, although it was by accident; the two agents found Leonid in 1953 and they took the young man to the Immortal City under Rome. thumb|right|250px|Picking up Leonid with Nathaniel Richards Three years later, Tesla returned as a cyborg and infiltrated the Immortal City to reunite with Leonid, his adoptive son, and take down Newton. Agents Richards and Stark battled him in a rematch but they damaged his core, thus causing it to self-destruct. Richards touched the core in an attempt to avert this but exposure to the core's quantum energy accidentally gave him the ability to move through time. Coupled with the explosion, Richards, Stark, Tesla, and Tesla's pigeon were all flung roughly 600,000 years into the future. Spending days in a seemingly abandoned Earth, they eventually encountered Tesla's pigeon as a shapeshifting woman, Mina, and she led them to Tesla's dying body. Setting aside their enmity, they worked together to restore Tesla and use Richards' new abilities go back to Immortal City in the past. thumb|left|Return to the Immortal City with Nikola Tesla, Mina, and Nathaniel Richards However, when they returned to the Immortal City, four years had passed and they found it to be in a state of warfare. The Brotherhood of the Shield had been divided between Isaac Newton, the current master who believed in fate, and Leonardo da Vinci, a returning former Patriarch of the Shield from the past who believed in free will. Newton also had the belief that the world will end in 2060 and that it must be served. Having gone far beyond 2060, the returning time travellers disagreed which led to a trial where Leonid sided with Leonardo. fields.notes: Regarding Howard's death, he told Nathaniel Richards when they joined the Brotherhood of the Shield that he planned to fake an automobile accident. Roxxon has claimed to have assassinated Howard. These were both dismissed in where the virtually omniscient Progenitor shows Tony the exact moment of Howard's death and the issue directly addresses that it is neither a faked death or an assassination. It is possible for him to have gotten into a real accident before his planned fake accident. If his death was truly faked, it would beg the question of what happened to Maria Stark, as Tony had lost both of his parents.

howard stark sr.origin: Born to Isaac Stark Jr. and being the grandson of Isaac Stark Sr., Howard Anthony Stark Sr. was a genius businessman and inventor from Richford, New York who owned Stark Industries at a young age and industrialized it during his tenure before passing ownership down to his son Howard Jr. when he presumably died or retired. In 1932, Stark Sr. built a townhouse at 890 Fifth Avenue that would later be donated by his grandson Tony to become the Avengers Mansion. According to his grandson, he also "made a killing" in the local mines which later went onto his son Howard to continue on doing. In 1963, Stark Sr. built a rotating wheel in Oregon called the Stark Needle which later became an iconic attraction in the area.

howard the duck.origin: ===Early Life=== Howard the Duck was hatched on Duckworld, an alternate Earth in an alternate universe where intelligent life evolved from ducks. Duckworld resembles mankind's Earth in an astounding number of ways, including the fact that ducks speak English. He was the son of Ronald and Henrietta, a working class Roman Catholic couple living in New Stork. He had two siblings, his sister, Theresa and his brother, Orville. As a child, he discovered an amazing potential intellect; however, he was continuously bullied by other children as a result. He eventually decided to give up on his studies, completely wasting his potential. Further details about Howard's past on Duckworld are still unknown. Indeed, there are conflicting accounts as to the circumstances surrounding his disappearance. ===Arrival on Earth=== Howard vanished from his homeworld when the power-hungry Hell-Lord Thog the Nether-Spawn used his demonic powers to cause the interdimensional Cosmic Axis to shift. Howard was dislodged from his home dimension and dropped into the middle of the Florida Everglades on Earth-616 at the Man-Thing's Swamp, the site of this world's Nexus of All Realities, a place from which travel to all other dimensions is said to be possible. In an effort to set the Cosmic Axis right and return home, the reluctant Howard joined up with Korrek of Ktharta, who also came from another dimension, the young Earth-born sorceress Jennifer Kale, the wizard Dakimh the Enchanter, and the Man-Thing, the guardian of the Nexus. The battle against Thog ended for Howard when he fell from the other-dimensional Stepping Stones of Oblivion. ===Cleveland and Garko, the Man-Frog=== He landed back on Earth-616 in the city of Cleveland, Ohio, where he first faced the menace of Garko, the Man-Frog. ===Bessie the Hellcow=== Howard the Duck wanted to establish a reputation in Cleveland. As such, he sought to earn a position in the Cleveland Police Department by catching this mysterious farm stalker. During the investigation, he found Bessie the Hellcow, who attacked him, but Howard kept her at bay with a makeshift cross. During the fight, he used a mallet and a wooden stake to seemingly end the blood-sucking bovine's Hellish existence once and for all. Despite his heroism, however, Howard was still denied a position on the Cleveland police force, much to his dismay. ===Meeting Beverly Switzler=== In Cleveland, Howard first met the young life model Beverly Switzler, who was a captive of the costumed criminal accountant Pro-Rata. Howard and Beverly escaped and began living together. Although Howard attempted to live as normal a life as he possibly could, considering that he was an anthropomorphic talking duck in a world of human beings, he continually ran afoul of various unusual menaces, including the Turnip Man, Count Macho, the Winky-Man, Emile "The Goat" Klout, and the Gingerbread Man. Howard came to public notoriety when he became a candidate for the United States Presidency on a very minor party ticket. He was even the target of an assassination plot, as someone had hired Doctor Angst and his group, the Band of the Bland, to kill him. Howard defeated his would-be assassins with the help of the Defenders and they were sent to prison. As it turned out, the assassination was unnecessary, as the general populace refused to believe that Howard was a real talking duck, thinking of him instead as a dwarf in a duck suit. As a result, the public dismissed his candidacy as a joke. He continued to battle villains such as the Bellhop, Le Beaver, Kong Lomerate, the Kidney Lady, the Rev. Joon Moon Yuc and his cult, the Yuccies, and Roxxon. ===Doctor Bong=== Howard's arch-enemy was Doctor Bong. Through cleverness, persistence, and just plain good (if not dumb) luck, he always managed to either defeat, or escape from, his adversaries. ===S.O.O.F.I.=== Howard went up against a hate group called S.O.O.F.I. (Save Our Offspring From Indecency) who were "trying to restore order to the world". ===Bzzk'joh=== While relaxing in his apartment, Howard was attacked by a salt shaker with arms and legs sitting on a giant housefly, but they were unable to defeat him. Dakimh the Enchanter and the Man-Thing arrived to ask Howard for his help and he was reluctantly transported to the Castle in the Sky over the Land Between Night and Day, where they were reunited with Korrek of Ktharta and Jennifer Kale, who were both surprised to discover that Howard was still alive after all this time. Dakimh brought all of them there to battle the demon Bzzk'joh. Bzzk'jho attacked them first and Jennifer was forced to use her power to bring to life NAAC-P30 and 2-2 2-2, two Druid Droids that helped Howard, Korrek, and the Man-Thing stop jho. When Howard still refused to help, Korrek threatened him. Howard conceded when he tried to use the gun that was given to him by Dakimh and it turned out to only shoot a comedic flag. Riding Dakimh's spaceship, the Epoch Weasel, into the universe to get to

In an unpublished script by Steve Gerber, it was revealed that on Howard's pre-warp homeworld, his parents were named Dave and Dottie instead of Ronald and Henrietta. Though the script remained unpublished, and Marvel official website listed Dave and Dottie as his parents without any explaination. It was later fully confirmed by the Marvel Appendix profiles for Duckworld-791021 and Duckworld-85197 that Dave and Dottie were indeed Howard's true parents. Howard was featured in both of the Marvel Swimsuit Special one-shots.
fields.trivia: As per , Howard possesses the ability to grow whiskers out of his bill. Howard's phone number is (555)-DUK-DICK. Doctor Strange cast a spell on Howard which makes his tail feathers grow longer every time that he calls Strange a jerk. Back in the 1970s, The Walt Disney Company threatened to sue Marvel Comics over Howard the Duck's similarities in design to . Marvel capitulated to Disney's demands, which included that they had to make Howard look like a design sheet that Disney supplied. The most notable difference was the inclusion of pants in the revised design. In which was written by Howard's creator, Steve Gerber, Howard was replaced by a duplicate in the mainstream Marvel Universe of Earth-616, and changed his name to Leonard the Duck. Gerber's intent was to "take back" his characters, but it was not acknowledged by either the company or the fans, and Gerber eventually killed off Leonard. However, Chip Zdarsky, the writer of , wrote the character as though he was the clone out of respect for the late Gerber. In the miniseries, Howard was merged with Deadpool to become Deadpool the Duck. Howard's full name was first revealed in . In the panel where this reveal was mentioned, a footnote by writer Chip Zdarsky urged all Marvel wikis to update themselves with this information. Before this retcon, originally his last name appears to have 5 or 6 letters, to start with a "P" (or "B" or "R") and end with a "K", as seen when he erased it from a paycheck. On Howard's "homeworld", the colloquial expression "hair of the dog" is replaced with "claw of the eagle".

howie bridger.name: Howie Bridger
howie bridger.origin: The mailman Howie Bridger was chosen by Loki Laufeyson in one of his plots against Thor Odinson. Loki modified this mortal so that he would look like the Man-Beast and rampage through the city of Oberlin, Ohio, saying not a single word—although the original Man-Beast was able to speak. This attracted Thor's attention. Thor battled this person but, eventually, the false Man-Beast collapsed and returned to his previous identity. A policeman identified Bridger, explaining that, while the person looked like Bridger and had his clothes, was sixty-something years old while Bridger had been twenty-something until then.

howie darp.name: Howie Darp
howie darp.origin: Howie Darp was picked to be the official photographer on the first interplanetary trip. During his trip to the planet Zoonga, Howie stole and used a Zoonganian camera to take a picture of Earth against the will of the Zoonganians who described their cameras as weapons. While back on Earth Howie developed the negative which he accidently burned and when that happened he and the entirety of Earth turned black and white as if they were a photo negative. After confessing his crime of stealing and using the camera Howie convinced them to allow him to return to space and take another photo to fix his mistake. After taking another photo and returning to Earth to develop it he soon learned that the photo turned out white which resulted in the entire Earth also turning white.

howlee barry.name: Howlee Barry
howlee barry.first_appearance: Marvel Apes: Prime Eight Special Vol 1 2
howlee barry.origin: Howlee Barry was a popular Hollywood actress on Earth-95019. Among her best-known roles was her portrayal of Storm in the X-Simian films, a performance that helped establish her as one of the entertainment industry's most recognizable stars. She was also known for having appeared as one of the leading women associated with the adventures of James Bonzo. Sometime after Iron Mandrill had unknowingly become infected with the zombie plague known as the Hunger, Jarvis informed him that Howlee Barry had requested to see him. Unaware of the true nature of Tony's condition, she sought contact with the industrialist shortly before the infection began to spread more openly throughout society.

howler.name: Howler
howler.origin: Howler was a young Mutant that was captured and mistreated by the Word of Strength, a group of people that treated him like an animal and forced him to fight other mutants. He eventually escaped to the Haven House, the headdquarters of the Louisiana X-Men. Monet St. Croix reached to him after he murdered all of the Haven House chickens in a fit of rage and calmed him down. He was given hospitality by the St. Juniors in the Haven's barn while another X-Man, Wolverine listened to his story. After he understood the X-Men wanted to avenge him, he left the barn, thanking his hosts.

howling wolf.name: Howling Wolf
howling wolf.origin: Howling Wolf was a Native American criminal who was active during the days of the American Frontier. He was incarcerated in a Dallas prison until he broke out in the year 1846. Desiring revenge against the white men who imprisoned him, Howling Wolf began traveling across Texas setting fire to ranches by night and sleeping by day. His reign of terror attracted the attention of the Texas Kid who tracked Howling Wolf for days. Howling Wolf got he drop on the Kid and buried him up to his neck in dirt intending to leave the western hero for the buzzards. The Kid whistled for his faithful horse Thunder who knocked Howling Wolf out with his hooves. Thunder then pulled the Texas Kid out of the ground and the hero shot Howling Wolf dead, leaving his corpse for the vultures to feed on.

hriedmar.name: Hriedmar
hriedmar.origin: Hriedmar was a Vanir and the tenant of an Inn. He had three sons: Regin, Fafnir, and Otr the Changer of Shapes from a witch of Svartalfheim, and lived with his sons in his inn. A day where he had been sent by Hriedmar as a human-sized otter to catch a supper, Otr encountered the young prince Odin Borson and the time-travelling Loki. While Odin was astonished by the creature who greeted them welcome, Loki quickly killed it. His meat was eaten, and from his fur were made two cloaks. When Loki and Odin came to the Inn and listened to Hriedmar talking about his third son, Odin quickly understood that they had killed Otr. As soon, Fafnir and Regin entered in arms, recognizing Otr's fur on the two travelers backs. While Regin intended to avenge in blood, Fafnir succumbed to Loki's tempting, implying a blood price with a ransom of gold. First going with Regin, Hriedmar accepted, taking Odin as hostage. Loki went to Andvari the Dwarf, killed him and stole his gold, but not before he could curse the it, who would be revealing the truth about people. After the two travelers departed, Regin was in favor of hunting them and all Asgardians down, but Hriedmar tried to appease him, before Fafnir was driven by the curse to stab them both, for him to keep the gold for himself. Hriedmar was killed, and Regin buried him and Otr, oathing the death of Fafnir and all Asgardians. Regin and Fafnir would eventually be killed, but those events would be the settings for crucial beings of the Nine Worlds.

hrimhari.name: Hrimhari
hrimhari.origin: ===Origin=== Descended from the great wolf Fenris, Hrimhari was one of the Wolf Gods of Asgard. He was born able to shapeshift into either a full wolf or wolfman. Little of his past was known, though he was known as a being of unquestionable honor and a friend to the Warriors Three. ===New Mutants=== Hrimhari encountered the New Mutant Rahne Sinclair when she and her teammates were stranded in Asgard due to the machinations of the Trickster God Loki. He instantly became enamored with her, and Rahne was likewise responsive to his feelings, though her stern upbringing by Reverend Craig initially prevented her from fully reciprocating. They were then captured by Loki and forced to wear a pair of Collars of Obedience. The collars turned them into monstrous wolves, Grimfang and Bleakheart, who were forced to track down the X-Men and New Mutants. Hrimhari and Rahne were eventually freed from Loki's control by Cannonball, who destroyed the collars with an enchanted sword. Hrimhari met Rahne again shortly after when the New Mutants return to Asgard to stop Hela's plan to reconquer Asgard with Valkyries. Hrimhari would help Rahne and the New Mutants stop Hela, although they would be separated yet again when Rahne returned to Earth. ===Ragnarok=== During the fall of Asgard, Frost Giants fought and killed Hrimhari's entire pack. Hrimhari tracked the Frost Giants quickly and while locked in battle with them, Hrimhari found Ragnarok. Hrimhari was reborn along with Asgard on Midgard (in Oklahoma). Hrimhari claims he was reborn for the purpose of finding his true love, Rahne Sinclair. thumb|200px|left|Hrimhari & Wolfsbane in the semi-human/semi-wolf forms ===X-Force=== While Rahne was recovering X-Force's second mission and her brainwashing in Angel's Aerie in the Colorado Rocky Mountains, Hrimhari found her, much to her surprise. Now reunited with his former lover, Hrimhari explained to Rahne the fall of Asgard, the murder of his pack, and his own rebirth on Midgard. Hrimhari then revealed to Rahne that he can now shapeshift into a fully human form, and they consummated their newly rekindled romance. thumb|left|150px But in the throes of afterglow, next to a roaring fire on the floor of Angel's Aerie, Hrimhari and Wolfsbane were attacked by three of the Frost Giants who slaughtered Hrimhari's pack. At first they fled, but then Hrimhari and Wolfsbane decided they could no longer run and turn to face their attackers. After narrowly defeating the Frost Giants, the seemingly uninjured Rahne fainted due to unknown causes, faintly called out for Elixir. Hrimhari rushed her back to Angel's Aerie, where he was met by Archangel and Warpath, who accompany him to the X-Men base on Utopia. Unfortunately, Utopia was under attack by Selene's undead mutants and Elixir was still in a comatose state due to the strain exerted by time traveling and in healing Surge from the modified Legacy Virus. Wolfsbane's condition continued to worsen, and in desperation Hrimhari called upon the death goddess Hela. Hela offered Hrimhari an even trade; a life for a life. Except she asked him to choose between his true love, Rahne, or their unborn child, which was the reason Rahne was dying. In the end, Hrimhari chose to exchange his life for Elixir's, knowing that Elixir could save both Rahne and his unborn cub. As Hrimhari and Hela disappeared, he told a recovered Elixir to save Rahne and tell her "I love her...and...I will find a way back to her." To save Wolfsbane's life, Elixir had to strengthen her body (to undefined limits) to endure the Asgardian embryo growing inside her. ===In Hel=== Hrimhari was taken by Hela to Niffleheim where he was forced to become a part of her army of the dead. When the X-Factor team traveled to Las Vegas to comfort Hela at her Inferno Club and save Pip the Troll, Hrimhari was among the army of death which fought them. Hrimhari was able to smell Rahne's scent on Shatterstar and immediately attacked him. Shatterstar was able to hold his own against Hrimhari and learned that Hrimhari was actually the father of Rahne's unborn child, not Rictor as Rahne had led the team to believe. ===War of the Realms=== During the Dark Council's invasion of Earth, Hrimhari made a deal with the Enchantress where he and Tier could be allowed to come to Earth and reunite with Rahne but on the condition that all three not interfere with in the Dark Council's war. Hrimhari and Tier also aided Sabretooth in bargaining with the Enchantress to give him a magic necklace that would allow Sabretooth to control Magik so he could use her teleportation powers to aid the Dark Council after the Black Bifrost was destroyed. However, Magik proved difficult to control. So, Sabretooth kidnapped Rahne so he could use her to force Magik to cooperate, but Hrimhari forced Sabretooth to back down. hu sha.name: Hu Sha
hu sha.origin: Hu Sha became a refugee when the Korean War broke out in the early 1950s. Her and her parents supported the United Nations that were on the side of South Korea. Early on in the war she befriended an American corporal named Joe who gave her perfume as a gift. Tragedy struck when her family home was attacked by the Chinese guerilla fighter known as Manchuria Mary who murdered her parents and stole the bottle of perfume. Seeking vengeance, Hu Sha vowed to capture Mary and turn her over to American soldiers who were active in the area. In her hunt for Mary, Hu Sha came across the American soldiers Battle Brady and Socko Swenski who were just recently knocked out by Manchuria Mary just moments earlier. When the two soldiers came around, and still unsure the true identity of Manchuria Mary began to argue over if Hu Shan was the woman they were after or not. Hearing Manchuria Mary coming back with a troop of female soldiers, Hu Sha knocked the two soldiers out again and hid in the bushes. When Manchuria Mary and her troops returned, Hu Sha got the drop on them and threatened to blow them up with a grenade. When Battle and Socko came around again, Hu Sha pointed out the real Manchuria Mary, recognizing the perfume she was wearing as the brand that she stole from her. Hu Sha then turned over Mary and her minions over to Socko and Battle. Hu Sha kissed Battle in thanks for his assistance in helping her avenge her family. However, Manchuria Mary and her minions managed to escape their captivity. Mary tracked down Hu Sha and took her prisoner in revenge for her earlier capture. Mary almost succeeded in burning Hu Sha alive, but Hu Sha was rescued by Battle Brady and Socko Swenski who tracked down Manchuria Mary again. When Mary and her minions were taken prisoner again, Hu Sha kissed Battle again for saving her life.

hu ri.name: Hu-Ri
hu ri.origin: thumb|left|Undercover as Harry Charles Hu-Ri was a member of Wakandan Dora Milaje during the 1930s. As part of their mission to guard and protect the M'kraan Crystal inside the Temple of Inanna in Uruk, Babylon, she was send by the current Wakandan King on an undercover assignment to Siracusa, Sicily as pilot Harry Charles. To interfere with the ongoing Sixth Excavation of Babylon by the Nazi Party, the Wakandans joined with the other Allied powers in order to keep the M'kraan Crystal out of the Nazi hands, and other undercover Wakandans arranged for "Harry" to pilot Peter Parker and Dr. Huma Bergmann to Berlin. In Berlin they made contact with American agent Byron Ironsides, who directed them to Istanbul. "Harry" flew the pair to the Turkish capital, where they were joined by another agent codenamed "Checkpoint Red". The four of them proceeded to Uruk, where Huma was revealed to be allied with the Nazis, forcing Hu-Ri to reveal herself as a Wakandan. With the help of Ironsides she, along with Red and Spider-Man, was able to escape the Nazi ambush and together they proceeded inside the Temple of Inanna. Only one of the Dora Milaje could open the door to the Tomb of Heaven and the M'kraan Crystal, which Huma accomplished by having Electro attack them. Electro threw Hu-Ri and the Cicada Stone at the door and the Stone's energies opened it and exposed the way to the Underworld itself. The energies of the Cicada Stone in proximity of the M'kraan Crystal briefly changed Hu-Ri and Parker into spider-like forms, but the effects quickly wore off. Huma Bergmann revealed herself to be the Goddess Inanna in the flesh and Hu-Ri and Checkpoint Red attempted to distract her to no success. However, Spider-Man was able to connect the Cicada Stone to the M'kraan Crystal, weakening its structure, after which one well-placed shot destroyed it along with Inanna. Parker, Hu-Ri and Checkpoint Red were later extracted out of Babylon by Ironsides.

hua mulan.name: Hua Mulan
hua mulan.origin: Little is detailed about Hua Mulan's life before Dreadpool began murdering the inhabitants of the Ideaverse, however it can be presumed that it followed much the same path as Hua Mulan from the ballad . Using H.G. Wells' Time Machine, Sherlock Holmes recruited Hua Mulan, alongside Beowulf, Natty Bumppo, and Dr. Watson to help stop Dreadpool from destroying the Ideaverse. Holmes and his allies discovered the chaos left in Dreadpool's wake on the Island of Doctor Moreau, 1896, Lilliput, 1699, and Rome, 44 B.C.. Sherlock's allies eventually met up with Dreadpool and Frankenstein's Monster in Paris, 1627, after they had slain the Three Musketeers. Mulan had Natty Bumppo thrown onto her sword, which seemingly killed him. Later in the battle, as Dreadpool tried to escape, she cut off the hand with his teleporter.

huang zhu.name: Huang Zhu
huang zhu.origin: Huang Zhu was with the nationalists in China during it's civil war, after which he joined Hydra. The Warlord committed genocide on the Mnnzz' Guthir tribe, exterminating them all except for Princess Xantia. Taking their land, he established his base of operations in an ancient temple complex which had been built by the Eternals. In Hydra's opium fields were genetically-engineered "super-poppies". He organized a martial arts tournament, inviting martial artists from around the world to participate, in what they soon learned were death matches. On the night of the tournament, S.H.I.E.L.D. attacked his operation. Xantia took advantage of the opportunity and killed the Warlord, meanwhile SHIELD burned the opium fields.

hub.name: Hub
hub.species: Depowered Mutant, temporary repowered by Terrigenesis
hub.origin: Hub was one of the few survivors after Cassandra Nova programmed her Wild Sentinels to decimate the island of Genosha, killing over 16 million mutants. Somehow she found other survivors and allied herself with Unus the Untouchable and his gang. She was a very valuable asset on the island since all forms of transport were eradicated or made useless by the resulting electromagnetic damage. Inside of the gang, she became close friends with Hack and the two of them began to doubt if Unus' exclusive, clique-like strategy was the best way. ===M-Day=== When mentally ill Scarlet Witch removed the mutant gene from most of the mutant population, Hub was one of the many who lost her powers. However, Quicksilver—as an act of penance for his part in the worldwide depowering—stole some Terrigen Crystals from the Inhumans in an attempt to repower some mutants. He started his mass efforts in Genosha and effectively restored the abilities of many on the island including Wicked, Freakshow, and Callisto. When this last started to suffer from her restored powers, Hub sent her to the Victoria Hospital at Mahé Island in the Seychelles, going close to death using her own twisted powers. She was later taken into medical care with the other refugees by the O*N*E, at the same hospital where Callisto, and the effects of the Mists eventually faded away, leaving the Genoshans powerless.

hubert carpenter.name: Hubert Carpenter
hubert carpenter.origin: Hubert Carpenter lived with Humbert, an eccentric uncle who was also a mad scientist. Humbert used experimental technology to enhance Hubert's physical abilities. Apparently, the dim-witted individual decided to do nothing more with his powers than to make a life of petty crime. He made his first known appearance as one of the villains battling the Defenders, only to be taken out by their erstaz associate, Frog-Man. He slipped back into obscurity, surfacing again when the White Rabbit wanted to form a league of past Frog-Man villains to gain revenge on the crime-fighting amphibian. This plan ended in failure as well, as the so-called "Terrible Two" were defeated by Frog-Man and Spider-Man. ===Fear Itself=== Deadpool, seeing the chaos caused by the rampage of the Serpent's Worthy, manipulates the Walrus into thinking that he has been chosen to wield a magical hammer. Unknown to Deadpool, the hammer Walrus received actually did have magical properties when exposed to a full Moon. Greatly strengthened by the hammer's power, the once small time criminal proceeded to cause chaos and destruction in New Mexico, almost killing Deadpool on multiple occasions. In the end, Deadpool managed to trick Walrus into entering the windowless basement of a sheriff's office where the hammer became powerless and Deadpool could take advantage of the sheriff's weapon's cache. ===All-New, All-Different Marvel=== Walrus later allied himself with Goldbug and White Rabbit, but the trio were captured by Spider-Woman. Taken to The Cellar, a recently built maximum security prison run by Empire Unlimited, Walrus was placed in a glass tube alongside Ox. When Ox asked Shannon Stillwell how they are supposed to live like this, Shannon stated that they wouldn't, and then proceeded to put them into stasis within their tubes. Walrus was presumably freed alongside all the other Empire Unlimited captives when Regent's plans were thwarted by Spider-Man, Iron Man, and Mary Jane Watson.

hubert hoopler.name: Hubert Hoopler
hubert hoopler.origin: Hubert Hoopler was an industrialist who came into contact with Juniper Fields, an inventor who had created a compound that could enhance the memory of anyone who drank it. Fields proposed to sell Hoopler the formula for a million dollars, and Hoopler, gripped by greed, said he was willing to buy it from him but he had to leave him the bottle. Fields accepted because it was impossible to reproduce the mixture without his instructions, but in any case it was not what Hoopler thought of doing. As soon as Fields left his office, Hoopler drank all the contents of the bottle and his memory grew disproportionately, in fact his idea was to destroy the formula so that he would be the most intelligent person and with his intelligence earn money. So the next day, Hoopler gave the agreed upon to Fields asking for the guarantee that he would not reveal the formula to anyone, and Fields replied that he did not have to worry because with the money received he intended to retire to a desert island far from everyone. Hoopler then, as soon as Fields left, destroyed the formula and called the board of directors of a company that he intended to scale and by churning out his new eloquence he amazed those present but suddenly he felt something in his brain and immediately his intellectual abilities plummeted. Shocked by what had happened he returned to his office and took back the bottle from which he had drunk and saw that under the bottle there was a sticker that he had not noticed before and that it was written that the serum lasted 24 hours and to keep a refill on hand. Adding insult to injury, because in addition to the knowledge he had acquired with the serum, his natural knowledge had also gone, making him as intellectually capable as an elementary school child.

hubert meese.name: Hubert Meese
hubert meese.origin: Hubert Meese was a man who employed Ms. Kelman as his secretary. During a work session, Meese dictated a letter and then asked Kelman to read it back to him. Instead of responding normally, she suddenly appeared dazed and unresponsive for several moments before abruptly flying into a violent rage. Without warning, Ms. Kelman lashed out and kicked Meese in the face while screaming that she hated him. Neither Meese nor Kelman realized that her behavior was the result of a wave of demonic influence affecting people across the country at the time.

hubert st johns.name: Hubert St. Johns
hubert st johns.origin: A wealthy but near-morbidly overweight individual, Hubert St. Johns arranged for scientists in his employ to capture the Hulk so that he could replicate the Hulk's gamma transformation and harness the Hulk's physical power for himself. However, although the effort succeeded in granting him the power of the gamma rays, St. Johns made a significant miscalculation; all previous examples of gamma mutation had affected people with relatively ordinary muscular structures, with their new physiques the result of the gamma radiation amplifying what was already there, but all his body gave the gamma radiation to work with was fat. As a result, he simply became even fatter, his body collapsing under its own weight.

hubie packer.name: Hubie Packer
hubie packer.origin: Teenage brothers Bert and Hubie Packer were criminals who travelled to Medina County, Ohio, with the idea of looting the Bar with No Name. Several supervillains had been killed in a massacre there, and some of their specialized weapons had not been found yet. The mercenary group Wild Pack was hired to stop them, and they sent Rocket Racer, but the Packers, known collectively as the Packrats, got rid of the Racer temporarily, found the Bar and got the Bird-Man and Cyclone's suits. With the help of sympathetic sheriff Andy Taylor, the Racer recovered and tracked the Packrat to the Bar. Although the Packers were suited, the Racer first incapacitated Hubie (the Bird-Man), then defeated Bert (the Cyclone). Hubie recovered enough to pick a sword in his second wind, but the sheriff got him down. Both criminals were arrested.

huey moon.name: Huey Moon
huey moon.species: Human who possesses a rare recessive gene dating back to when mankind discovered fire, that gene gives him various fire related abilities.
huey moon.origin: ===Early Life=== Huey Moon was an homeless man living in a junkyard in Philadelphia, he possessed a rare gene that gave him fire-related abilities. Everything he had would burn, including his clothes, and because of that, he decided to isolate himself in a junkyard where there was nothing to burn nor anyone to hurt. ===Joining Miracleman's New Gods=== When Miracleman and his companions decided to look for other superhumans living on Earth to join them, they found Huey Moon, and talked to him, trying to convince him to join them. He was finally going to have company and a place to live without worrying about his powers hurting anyone, and he would be able to use them to help mankind instead, so after some reluctance, he accept the offer. He was later part of the group of heroes that fought and defeated Johnny Bates in London at the cost of Aza Chorn's life. After the defeat of Johnny Bates, Miracleman and his companions decided to fix planet Earth and rule it as benevolent gods from the top of their fortress, Olympus, which Miracleman had created from the destroyed city of London. As one of Earth's New Gods, Huey Moon was responsible for Earth's energy demands. He created windmill forests, coastal waterwheels, and converted obsolete space weaponry into reflector satellites. He was later seen with his fellow New Gods on top of Olympus celebrating.

hugh bradley.name: Hugh Bradley
hugh bradley.origin: thumb|left|200px|Hugh Bradley Hugh Bradley was part of a Mojave Indian Agency that traded with the Native Americans that lived in the Mojave Desert. At some point during World War II, he became a traitor to his country by allying himself with the Imperial Japanese and became a spy, due to promises of great wealth. He assisted in subversive activities by using his knowledge of the Native Americans to create the secret identity of the Vulture. Gathering a group of easily manipulated Native Americans to form the "Vulture Tribe", then arming them to attack a shipment of explosives being shipped from Camp Lehigh to Camp Mojave. Unfortunately for the Vulture, among the caravan were Private Steve Rogers and company mascot James Buchanan Barnes who managed to fight off the Vulture and his men as Captain America and Bucky. Later, resuming his civilian guise, Hugh then presented himself to the military with information on the Vulture Tribe. Feeding them misinformation how the tribe is an ancient society that hates white people, he offered to try and ferret out members among the Blackhawk tribe in the area. That night, resuming his guise as the Vulture, Bradley and his minions caught Captain America and Bucky snooping around the ancient Native American village which they were hiding out in. The Vulture had Captain America knocked out and took Bucky and a prospector named Pete (who was unfortunate enough to be in the wrong place at the wrong time) prisoner. Captain America soon caught up to the Vulture and, deducing that he was really a Japanese spy, battled him one-on-one. Knocking out the Vulture, Cap went looking for Bucky and Pete in the Vulture's temple hideout. There, the revived Vulture activated a massive robot disguised as a statue of a Native American idol. While Cap was busy fighting off this robot, the Vulture attempted to kill him with a grenade. However, the resulting explosion only separated the two men between a wall of rubble. Returning to his prisoners, the Vulture had Bucky and Pete tossed into a pit that was rapidly flooded with water, hoping to drown them. Captain America soon freed Bucky and Pete, and they caught the Vulture with a Japanese general plotting their next move. A fight broke out, and Cap, Bucky and Pete were able to beat everyone into submission. With the Vulture defeated, the Japanese soldiers and rogue Native Americans surrendered. Captain America then unmasked the Vulture revealing him to be Hugh Bradley. Bradley's status after unrevealed, but presumably he was taken into military custody. His fate following the end of World War II remains unrecorded.

hugh dare.name: Hugh Dare
hugh dare.origin: Ned Chapel was a manor blacksmith on the Armatage Estate who was was gifted with the enchanted armor of Sir Steel. He fought for England during the First World War, and joined the Freedom's Five. In 1917, when the Freedom's Five were in their base planning an attack on a mad scientist called Dr. Ursula Frankenstein, the heroes received a message that mysterious creatures were attacking the streets of London, which were later revealed to be invaders from Mars. The invasion was repelled with the help of a mysterious team with high-tech led by a man later identified as Eben Stafford, and the aliens were forced to flee. He died in 1919, during an influenza epidemic.

hugh jones.name: Hugh Jones
hugh jones.origin: Hugh Jones was the president of Roxxon Oil. left|thumb He was kidnapped by Madame Viper and her Serpent Squad and was forced into contact with the Serpent Crown of Lemuria. This evil influence later precipitated Jones to lead a criminal conspiracy to overthrow the U.S. Government. He conspired with Buzz Baxter to hire the Squadron Supreme to defeat the Avengers and transported them all to the Squadron's universe, where the President of the US was also under the control of the Serpent Crown. He was eventually defeated by the Avengers after they returned from the Squadron's world and Thor overcame the crown-controlled Orka. Jones continued to have a mental link with the Serpent Crown and was able to locate the crown even though the Vision disposed of it in the Atlantic Ocean. Later the Thing was able to separate Jones from the accursed crown. Unfortunately for Jones, breaking the link between Jones and the Serpent Crown caused the chairman to become mentally ill. He was eventually replaced as the president of Roxxon.

Some time later, Black Knight left to Weirdworld and Key returned to the team and was appointed their new leader.

hugo dummy.name: Hugo (Dummy)
hugo dummy.origin: Hugo's partner Gabbo astonished audiences for years with his ability to throw his voice and make it seem that his dummy was alive. Their comedy routine won them accolades and invitations to prestigious events. The dummy, however, was actually Hugo dressed in a wooden mask. The duo were later employed by Luther Cragg as part of projecting a legitimate business front on the riverboat he was using as a mobile base of operations for his criminal activities. Gabbo and Hugo would entertain the unsuspecting audiences with the performance of their renowned act. Gabbo, however, played another role in Cragg's operations, for he would send Hugo to rob the guests' rooms while they slept, taking advantage of Hugo's size to slip in and out unnoticed. Cragg and his men were eventually opposed by the Rawhide Kid who had had dealings with Cragg before. This time, although the Kid faced an entire riverboat full of hired guns working for Cragg, Hugo stepped up to aid the Kid. Hugo's sudden turn against Gabbo was credited with ending Cragg's operation, though Hugo had been dissatisfied with his criminal career, and found his robberies to be distasteful, and pretending to be a dummy simply insulting. It was the Rawhide Kid's vouching for Hugo that spared him from a jail sentence with the rest of the crew, and the Kid went on to spend several months teaching Hugo how to handle a gun and become a trick shot. Hugo had once feared that performing in a carnival would be yet another indignity he would have to suffer because of his size, but his sharpshooting performances won him genuine admiration. hugo dummy.bio: Hugo's partner Gabbo astonished audiences for years with his ability to throw his voice and make it seem that his dummy was alive. Their comedy routine won them accolades and invitations to prestigious events. The dummy, however, was actually Hugo dressed in a wooden mask. The duo were later employed by Luther Cragg as part of projecting a legitimate business front on the riverboat he was using as a mobile base of operations for his criminal activities. Gabbo and Hugo would entertain the unsuspecting audiences with the performance of their renowned act. Gabbo, however, played another role in Cragg's operations, for he would send Hugo to rob the guests' rooms while they slept, taking advantage of Hugo's size to slip in and out unnoticed. Cragg and his men were eventually opposed by the Rawhide Kid who had had dealings with Cragg before. This time, although the Kid faced an entire riverboat full of hired guns working for Cragg, Hugo stepped up to aid the Kid. Hugo's sudden turn against Gabbo was credited with ending Cragg's operation, though Hugo had been dissatisfied with his criminal career, and found his robberies to be distasteful, and pretending to be a dummy simply insulting. hugo barge.name: Hugo Barge
hugo barge.origin: Hugo Barge was a cutthroat and ruthless businessman. Not only that, but he was just a mean person in general, as one time he wanted to buy the land of the only play area in town in order to pave it over because the children annoyed him. The only thing as large as Barge's mean streak was his voracious appetite, he was constantly eating. One day he went to the doctor who told him that he was morbidly obese and must lose weight for his health. Unwilling to sacrifice his love of eating, Barge tried every crackpot scheme and diet pill on the market, but did not lose any weight. Believing that the answer was in Europe, he flew to that continent and tried every ancient remedy and potion that he could find, but he actually put on ten more pounds. Finally, he was told to see Korumbu, a gypsy medicine man. If anyone was to have a weight loss potion which worked, it would be him. Barge forced his way into Korumbu's trailer and told him he wanted his weight loss potion and would pay any price. Korumbu tried to dissuade him, saying that the potion was not yet perfected and was still too dangerous. Barge, however, said that if he did not give it to him he would tell the authorities where the gypsies were hiding and they would be arrested for trespassing. At this, Korumbu gave Barge the potion, which did indeed cause Barge to lose weight almost immediately. The potion worked too well, however, and Barge had to constantly eat in order to keep himself from wasting away. A manhunt was started to find Korumbu, as Barge believed that he was the only one who could cure him, but it was as if Korumbu had simply disappeared.

hugo campbell.name: Hugo Campbell
hugo campbell.first_appearance: Amazing Spider-Man: Venom Inc. Alpha Vol 1 1
hugo campbell.origin: Hugo Campbell was one of the Alchemax security guards who escorted Flash Thompson out of Alchemax Tower. In reality Flash got himself kicked out on purpose so he could snatch a pass, and he stole Hugo's. Not long afterwards, Hugo Campbell was in charge of handling a sliver of tritium to be used as part of a demonstration in Alchemax Testing Facility. When the exhibition was attacked by the Goblin Nation, the Goblin King severed Hugo's right arm and used it to bypass the fingerprint lock of the vault containing Alchemax's remaining tritium supply. Agent Anti-Venom had applied symbiotic biomass on Hugo's wound to treat it, and after recovering his arm, reattached it. Hugo later confronted Mac Gargan when he tried to enter the building to search for Venom. When Hugo repeatedly denied Gargan entry and threatened to call security, Gargan attacked Hugo with his tail-blade.

fields.notes: Hugo Campbell's identity is plagued by inconsistencies: To begin with, Hugo Campbell first appears in a scene together with other two Alchemax security guards. Out of these three guards, one guard sports a moustache and has black hair, another is noticeably buff and balding, and the final one is pale and has brown hair. The guards are identified by Flash as Chet, Collin and Hugo. When addressing specifically Hugo, Flash aims his gaze to the buff guard. The ID Flash steals belongs to Hugo Campbell, and the photo on it is unmistakably of the buff guard. However, in a subsequent scene, the same three guards are walking up a set of stairs. The pale guard addresses the guard with a moustache as Hugo, mentioning it was his badge that got stolen. The buff balding guard reappears in and has his ID stolen by Black Cat. She notices his name is Hugo. The guard with the moustache reappears in , and is again identified as Hugo by Liz Allan, and recognized as such by Peter Parker.
fields.trivia: Hugo's first and last name are a probable reference to , protagonist of the comic series .

hugo cornelius.name: Hugo Cornelius
hugo cornelius.first_appearance: The Age of the Sentry Vol 1 1
hugo cornelius.origin: Dr. Hugo Cornelius developed the serum which gave Rob Reynolds the powers to become the Sentry. The pair worked together and the Sentry gave him a brain he retrieved from Cranio. The doctor placed the brain in his newly discovered "living gelatin" which allowed Gorax to regrow his body. He was immediately attacked by the Sentry, but Gorax absorbed some his his life force, knocking him out. He sent Lindy Lee and Scout back in time to retrieve the residual formula. After Gorax was stopped, Cornelius used his memory ray to wipe Lindy Lee's memory of Robert's identity.

hugo cragg.origin: After escaping from jail, Hugo Cragg heads for a deserted mansion to hide out until the heat is off. Then he discovers a strange closet in the house: after he puts something into it, the object disappears! He figures that if the objects disappear into another dimension, why not go there himself to hide from the police! He does, finding himself in the other dimension, but has no way back to Earth.

hugo danner.origin: As a fetus, Hugo Danner was injected with a serum made from insect blood by his father. When he grew up, he developed superhuman strength. When he was six years old and starting school, a large boy picked a fight with him. In self-defense, he picked up and flung the boy away. This sickened him and made him detest his strength. He would uproot trees in the forest so he could unleash his strength. He joined the French Foreign Legion at the outbreak of World War I.

hugo longride.name: Hugo Longride
hugo longride.origin: Hugo Longride was a sports agent who created the Underground Mutant Theatre in Hollywood, California and formed the combatants into the Gladiators, who would stage battles for the amusement of the audience. At some point he recruited the mutant named Alexander Flynn to work as a talent scout to find new mutants to fight in the arena. thumb|left|225px Hugo and Flynn came into conflict about the running of the Underground Mutant Theatre on several occasions, starting out with small differences of opinion and growing until they became major conflicts. Flynn then tried to use Dazzler and the other Gladiators in an attempt to usurp Hugo's position as leader of the group. The Gladitors sided with Flynn, and killed him. It turned out that Hugo was really a Doombot created by Doctor Doom in order to keep an eye on Flynn, who wanted to invade and conquer Latveria. With Hugo's destruction, Doctor Doom was alerted and came to the Underground Mutant Theatre to stop Flynn's plans, however, he witnessed Flynn being dealt with by the young mutant, Link.

hugo lopez.name: Hugo Lopez
hugo lopez.origin: Hugo Lopex was the child of an abusive mother, who discovered the Crawlers who lived below in the sewers. He preferred living them, but his sister, Juanita believed he had been kidnapped and enlisted the aid of Wonder Man and the Beast. The pair traveled down and found Hugo happy but returned him to his family when the Crawlers were attacked. Hugo escaped from his family and returned to the Crawlers and tried to convince Juanita to stay with them. The gang returned with explosives which blew out a wall and it sucked Hugo and the Crawlers out into the river. Their current fate and whereabouts are unknown.

hugo natchios.name: Hugo Natchios
hugo natchios.origin: Hugo Natchios was a businessman who later became the Greek Diplomat to the United States of America. During the birth of Elektra, it was revealed that her mother was gunned down by enemies of her father while vacationing on a yacht. However, Stavros revealed that her mother was shot by a hostage taker when she tried to help. As Elektra grew up, her father required that she train in the martial arts where she excelled. She was then required to go to law school, enrolling her Columbia University, where she met and had a serious relationship with a blind law student named Matthew Murdock. He was accidentally killed during a rescue attempt when he and Elektra were held hostage by armed terrorists in the administration building of Columbia University. However, after her father was gunned down by assassins, she went to the Mountain of the Chaste to train from them, but she was later dismissed by Stick for bearing too much emotion over the death of her father.

In an alternate reality story in (May 2011), years later, after Captain Britain had revealed his double identity to the world, this world's Travis asked him to come back to Darkmoor in order to assist on a new project, generating energy by the use of anti-matter particles. Unfortunately, the complex was almost immediately attacked again, this time by the cyborg mercenary Assassin-8 (working for the Secret Empire), and Travis found himself working frantically to stop a potentially catastrophic breach in the antimatter containment unit.

hui lin.name: Hui Lin
hui lin.species: Human possessing advanced longevity and regeneration thus rendering him virtually immortal
hui lin.origin: Hui Lin was born in 1320 in Nanjing, China. In 1368, Hui Lin killed a Mongolian soldier and gave him the message that the Khan's reign was over, stating that himself was the sword that would pierce Kublai Khan's heart. The Ming Dynasty then overthrew the Yuan Dynasty. He survived to the modern era because of his advanced longevity. ===Modern Era=== Hui Lin joined S.H.I.E.L.D. as Agent Sum. His status was so classified that Maria Hill had to ask twice herself what his expertise even was. When Carol Danvers, AKA Ms. Marvel was appointed to lead the Mighty Avengers, she put together her own team separate from them, Operation: Lightning Storm. He accompanied and assisted in her adventures with that team, being the only original team member to survive, besides Carol herself. Agent Sum aided Ms. Marvel in rescuing survivors and transporting them to the Raft at the battle of Manhattan during the Secret Invasion.

He was given birth by Gaea after she created a new race of mortals in the Fifth Sun. ===Apocalypse=== At some point , the mutant Apocalypse (En Sabah Nur) impersonated him. ===Reincarnation=== Aracely Penalba, member of the New Warriors and ward of Scarlet Spider, was revealed to be the "reincarnation" of Huitzilopochtli. Aracely adopted the superhero name "Hummingbird," an animal frequently associated with Huitzilopochtli.
