hypnos.name: Hypnos
hypnos.origin: Hypnos was the first spawn of Nyx, the Olympian goddess of the night. An outcast among the Olympians, Nyx longed for the peaceful slumber in the darkness before creation. When she noticed that her fellow gods found happiness in the children they bore, she tried to emulate them. Three nights after dreaming of the stillness of her lost slumber, she gave birth of Hypnos. thumb|left|Hypnos' birth Like his mother, Hypnos failed to find a place among the rest of the Olympians, remaining stoic and loyal to Nyx. Hypnos was eventually joined by two more siblings, the twins Apate and Dolos. Tensions between Nyx and her offspring, and the Olympians escalated into a war. The combined strength of the Olympians defeated Nyx and her children, and Zeus split the matriarch's soul into three Night Shards. Afterward, Nyx and her family were cast out into a prison of darkness, sealed by a spell that ensured their imprisonment for as long as the Sun shone upon the Earth. Out of her hatred, Nyx manifested Hypno's third sibling, Oizys. Hypnos and his family remained chained to their prison of darkness until the Modern Age. During a conflict between two Elders of the Universe, the Grandmaster and the Challenger, the Earth was briefly removed from its orbit around the Sun. With the spell of imprisonment broken, Nyx rallied her children against the Olympians. Believing the gods, the mortals and the universe itself to have all been spoiled after an eternity of mistreatment, Nyx set out to recreate the universe to her image, returning everything to a state of empty and pure darkness. When Nyx and her children arrived on Olympus, they slaughtered all the gods present in the scene, including Zeus, whose mind Nyx probed for the whereabouts of the Night Shards. thumb|left|Hypnos and the rest of his family Nyx dispatched Hypnos to Nightmare's Realm, where The Night That May Yet Be was located, and he besieged Nightmare's castle with an army of the manifestations of sleeping people. However, a group of Avengers had become aware of Nyx's return, and a portion of the team, the Hulk, Rocket Raccoon, and Hawkeye, were sent to Nightmare's Realm to intercept Hypnos. Hypnos squirreled away into Nightmare's castle while the heroes confronted his army and managed to obtain The Night That May Yet Be, but he was hunted down by the Hulk. After defeating Hypnos, the Hulk broke his neck and claimed the Night Shard for himself. Nyx eventually came back to life, and resurrected her children. Hypnos ambushed Hercules when he, Thor, and Loki sought them out and was struck by a thrown Oizys. He was cast into the Land Without Suns, but returned to Earth to be Nyx's informant when she chose to stay there.

fields.notes: The following is the original description for Hypnos written by writers Mark Waid, Al Ewing, and Jim Zub for Joshua James Shaw, the designer of Nyx and her children: "Hypnos is noble, upstanding, a general-type. He's also an ends-justify-the-means type--he'll willingly follow his mother in whatever she wants to do and believe it's right because she said it. He's also the sleep of reason--the sleep people are in before they get "woke" to the reality of things. He knows he's good, therefore what he does is good and his family is also good. He's unquestioning. Hypnos appears to be a strong Greek warlord, but his armor is black sections rimmed with silver accents instead of the red and gold or earth tones we'd expect. His helm has an ornate cover over his eyes so we cannot see them (and we never will), making his mouth a bit more creepy. He wields a pair of classic -style Grecian blades that not only cut their opponent but also sap their strength and clarity." In the 1980s, Zeus created new gods, including Ataros, "God of the Video Arcade", "brother to Hypnos and Thanatos." This relationship was seemingly metaphorical rather literal (at least for Hypnos whose origin has since been revealed).
fields.trivia: Hypnos is, out of Nyx and her children, the character with the most noticeable influence from ancient Greek clothing, armor, and sculpture. His winged head is a direct translation and amalgamation of a few ancient stone and metal sculptures of the Greek god from antiquity. The front of Hypnos' belt is a simplified abstraction of a Greek sun and moon eclipse motif.

hyppus.name: Hyppus
hyppus.origin: Hyppus was one of the Elder Gods of Earth, created by the energies of the Demiurge. For millions of years, the Elder Gods ruled Earth unchallenged. After the Mother of Horrors' corruption began to change the creatures of Earth, Set grew hungry. Hyppus was killed and devoured by his sibling, who absorbed his life force to empower himself, and was thus the victim of the first murder on Earth. Following Hyppus' death, most of the Elder Gods would perish, devouring each others or consumed by the Demogorge. in the ensuing Godwar and subsequent Great Culling.

hyram heale.name: Hyram Heale
hyram heale.origin: thumb|left|117px|Hyram Heale Hyram Heale was a window washer who owned the Hi-Low Window Washing Company. In 1947 he was hired to clean the rooms of circus stars including Mike Galen, who was a star attraction at the circus as the "Human Fly", using a costume that was equipped with suction cups. One day while Heale was washing the windows of an office building he watched as a man placed jewels into a safe. Inspired to steal them, Hyram stole a spare Human Fly costume and attempted to break into the office and by scaling the outside walls. His attempt was witnessed by Captain America and Bucky who rushed to stop him, however the Human Fly managed to escape after he knocked Captain America off the building. The next night, the Human Fly was off to another robbery when he was once more spotted by Cap and Bucky as they patrolled the city in a helicopter. The Human Fly jumped off the building and attempted to parachute to safety. However, Bucky jumped on him causing him to fall faster. Despite the rough landing, he managed to break free and escape. Convinced that Mike Galen was the Human Fly, Captain America and Bucky confronted him but learned that he was not and heard his suspicions about how the window washer might have stolen his spare costume. Going to the Hi-Low Window Washing Company, they found the place deserted. Looking for clues they found a newspaper article about the valuable stamp collection owned by lighthouse keeper John Moth. Rushing there, they clashed once more with the Human Fly. Outfought, the Fly attempted to escape down the lighthouse stairs but tripped over an alcove where Moth kept his food. This overturned a barrel of molasses which glued the Human Fly to the floor and allowed Captain America to capture and unmask him as Hyram Heale and turn him over to the authorities. Heale's subsequent activities are unknown.

hyrm.name: Hyrm
hyrm.origin: ===Preparing Ragnarök=== Hyrm was a Giant, as well as the pilot of the death ship Naglfar, made of the nails of the dead. He was among the foes of Asgard who assailed the Realm, seeking the weaknesses they could exploit at the time of Ragnarok. ===Ragnarök=== When Ragnarök finally came, Hymer entered in league with Loki, the Fenris Wolf, and also Ulik (whom he kept in leash), all equipped with hammers. They attacked Ymir-Krul during the funeral of Eitri, as Surtur was striking the Mold of Mjolnir, causing the Sacred Mountain to break and Ymir-Krul to crack. The blow and the ensuing battle cost the lives of the Enchantress and many others, and Sif's arm. Trying to fell Thor and prevent him from striking Loki's son Fenris, Hyrm struck Mjolnir at once along with his allies, causing the destruction of Ymir-Krul and extreme damages to Thor's hammer. The quartet then attacked Asgard, slaughtering its inhabitants and the Einherjar. There, they encountered Thor and his fellow Avengers, Iron Man and Captain America, and Iron Man killed Hymer while the others retreated.

After having lost her husband and one of her daughters, widowed Queen Ialamis was seduced by Sergianus, a young nobleman, who was actually Baron Sabaninus of Korveka in disguise. When Conan and his allies confronted the imposter and thwarted his plot to annex Khauran to Koth, Ialamis killed herself, leaving the young Taramis on the Khauranian throne.

ian boothby.name: Ian Boothby
ian boothby.origin: Ian Boothby was an intern working for Jane Foster and Darcy Lewis in London. He was with Jane and Darcy when they went looking for Erik Selvig and when they found the gravitational disturbance. After Jane went missing, Darcy and Ian called the police. After Jane returned and Thor took her with him to Asgard, Ian and Darcy left in search of Selvig. They had discovered that he had been arrested and placed in a home for the elderly. When Jane and Thor returned to Earth, Ian helped Jane, Darcy, and Erik set up the devices needed to help combat Malekith's convergence. After Ian saved Darcy's life by killing a Dark Elf with a car, they shared a kiss. They were then transported to Jane and Selvig's side, where they awkwardly addressed each other before Mjolnir flew by. After Thor defeated Malekith, Darcy and Ian resumed kissing.

ian fate.name: Ian Fate
ian fate.origin: Ian Fate was a reporter whose crime exposés sent the assassin Eric Payne after him. Unfortunately, his bomb did not kill Ian, but instead killed his wife Gloria and their son Brian. Ian set out to obtain revenge on Payne, and realized he needed to become a master in the mystic arts. He traveled to Tibet and developed his magic skills under an exiled seer until the seer learned of his darker motives, and Fate struck him down and fled. He traveled through multiple dimensions until he discovered a realm inhabited by an unnamed, green demon-like creatures and was able to persuade them to assist him. Fate then kidnapped Eric's estranged wife, Cory Payne, and requested to meet with Eric. He threatened to kill her and challenged Payne to stop him. Payne obtained the assistance of the Defenders and traveled to confront Fate. A brief struggle broke out but Fate was subdued by Doctor Strange. Payne tried to rescue his wife but she was killed by one of the demon creatures. However, it was revealed that Fate couldn't kill an innocent and had replaced her with the heroin addict "Sunshine". Payne tried to kill Fate but was stopped by Wonder Man. Strange left Fate with an occult psychiatrist but after a few weeks, Fate was able to escape and attempt to return to his demons, but arrived in Man-Thing's Swamp instead. Here he was met by the Man-Thing and the two made a connection. Fate attempted to disguise the Man-Thing and brought him to J. Jonah Jameson. Fate talked to Jameson about using the Daily Bugle to help stop all pain in the world. When Jameson told him this was impossible, Fate attacked him, but was confronted by Spider-Man. Man-Thing tried to help, but the fear from Fate caused him to burn, which only stopped when Jameson's fear distracted him. Spider-Man knocked the Man-Thing out of the building and the fight continued on the street below. Fate meanwhile was approached by Jameson who was able to convince him to stop this by asking what his wife and child would have thought of his actions. Fate teleports the weakened form of the Man-Thing back to his swamp and decided to stay with the Man-Thing. His current fate and whereabouts are unknown as he was never seen with the Man-Thing again.

ian fitzwilliam dare.name: Ian Fitzwilliam Dare
ian fitzwilliam dare.origin: Not much has been revealed regarding the history of the Scottish hero known as Templar prior to his appearance as a member of the First Line during the 1970s. Later, Templar retired from active adventuring with the First Line when he got married to his love, Rossalyn. Templar was also present as a member of the First Line during its final mission, defending the Earth against an invasion by the alien Skrulls. Templar was killed during the battle.

ian ilson.name: Ian Ilson
ian ilson.first_appearance: Captain America II: Death Too Soon
ian ilson.origin: Professor Ilson was a scientist researching a way to stop the ill effects of aging; to do so, he first had to find a way to speed aging. His research was public: Fellow scientist Dr. Simon Mills was aware of it. Ilson eventually forfeited his project. thumb|left|Ilson captured However, international terrorist General Miguel found that this research could produce a useful weapon. He arranged the kidnapping of Professor Ilson, which was violent. During the fight, Ilson managed to scrabble the letters "Migu" in a glass with his finger, to provide a hint. Ilson was then taken to Waterford Prison, Miguel's secret lair. Miguel forced Ilson to provide him a weapon, threatening 250 people (possible the population of Belleville) if Ilson did not meet the deadlines. Ilson agreed to work, hoping for a rescue. He finally provided Miguel with the weapon, and waited in his cell. thumb|right|Professor Ilson Dr. Mills had started an investigation on Ilson's kidnapping, and recruited Captain America. Captain America found Miguel's lair and raided it, rescuing Mills. From the very first moment, Captain America assured Ilson that he, Cap, knew that Ilson had been working under duress.

ian mcguire.name: Ian McGuire
ian mcguire.origin: Ian McGuire was a ruthless drug smuggler who preyed upon wealthy travelers along the Florida coast. While posing as a respectable young man, he gained the trust of the Bannister family and was invited aboard their yacht. Once underway, McGuire revealed his true nature when his gang seized the vessel, murdered Barbie Bannister's parents, and took the young woman prisoner. Intending to eliminate the sole surviving witness, McGuire underestimated Barbie's determination to survive. She escaped into the Everglades, prompting him to lead a relentless manhunt through the swamps alongside several of his men. During the pursuit, members of his gang fell victim to Man-Thing, whose presence was drawn by the fear surrounding the chase. Refusing to abandon the hunt, McGuire tracked Barbie to Citrusville and eventually to the home of Sheriff John Daltry. There he attempted to silence her permanently, but Barbie overcame her terror and fought back, defeating McGuire before contacting the authorities.

ian mcnee.name: Ian McNee
ian mcnee.origin: Ian McNee began his mystical training with the goal of becoming Sorcerer Supreme. After ten years, he challenged Dr. Strange for the title, and was defeated by Strange. Ian's activities after challenging Strange are largely unknown. It is known he acquired the First Tarot and set up a magic shop, the Corner Store on Creation in Brooklyn. Ian consulted the First Tarot and found many oddities with the state of magic. Drawing the deck, one of ten time, "The Magician" was himself one time out of ten, hinting at him being a possible future Sorcerer Supreme. Soon after, Ian dreamed that he was trapped in the Serpent's Sea, but was saved by a being appearing to be Oshtur. "Oshtur" asked Ian to gather the Cornerstones of Creation - the Sword of Bone, the Ebon Rose, the Serpent Crown, and the Black Mirror - in order to balance magic. Ian traveled through time and space to do so, encountering Ammut, Morgan Le Fay, Llyra, and (briefly) Marie Laveau during his quests. However, he learned the being who had appeared to him as Oshtur to send him on his quest was, in reality, Chthon in disguise, who had asked him to gather the items and attempted to corrupt the other cornerstones with the Darkhold. However, Ian managed to use the stones to undo the work of Chthon and banish him to the Flickering Realms. After this, the real Oshtur appeared to him and told him that he, along with his new partner Ashake, must work to repair the structure of magic. Eventually, McNee could not keep the Corner Store going, and consequently closed down, offering Darcy Lewis of the Emporium a good deal on his stock.

ian quinn.name: Ian Quinn
ian quinn.origin: Ian Quinn is a wealthy mining philanthropist and the owner of Quinn Worldwide which had diplomatic immunity in Malta. He had his soldiers use a gravity weapon and an excavator to abduct his former partner Franklin Hall from a S.H.I.E.L.D. convoy that was overseen by Agent Mack. When Ian Quinn had Franklin Hall brought to his house in Malta, he showed him the miniaturized gravity device secured through his vast fortune. Ian Quinn explained to Franklin Hall that he liberated him to continue his life's work with a full-scale version of the device, something Hall seemed eager to do. When Skye entered the party and made her way to find Ian Quinn, he quickly revealed that he allowed her access to the party in order to recruit her impressive talents as a member of the Rising Tide. Ian Quinn next gave a speech announcing to dignitaries that his new invention would allow them to circumvent governments and S.H.I.E.L.D. alike, during which Skye slipped away to find Quinn's office. However, Ian caught her in the act, for which she silently wrote on a pad that S.H.I.E.L.D. was spying them, and suggested to find somewhere to talk. Removing her earpiece, Skye explained to Ian how she managed to infiltrate S.H.I.E.L.D., as Ian Quinn corroborated that they tend to prey on those with records, providing a false sense of family in recruitment. Ian Quinn was quickly alerted to the security breach as Coulson entered Dr. Franklin's lab resulting in Quinn holding a gun to Skye. Though she quickly snatched it away and fled out the window rather than pull the trigger. During Grant Ward's fight with Ian's men, Quinn and his aide escaped to their helicopter. Quinn later supplied technology to two students, Donnie Gill and Seth Dormer (whose father was Quinn's lawyer) at S.H.I.E.L.D.'s Science and Technology Academy to develop a weather machine. The boys lured Leo Fitz to the academy to help them overcome problems with the device, and Quinn subsequently tricked them into activating it, but his promises to pick them up and pay them were hollow lies. He ordered that his plane be turned around and left them to die instead. Shortly thereafter, Quinn received a call from Coulson, warning that his plane will be shot down if he enters the territory of any S.H.I.E.L.D. ally. Quinn ended the call by telling him that the Clairvoyant says "hello." Weeks later, Quinn went to Italy to oversee the exchange of Project: Deathlok from Cybertek. He later caught Skye discovering Mike Peterson in a hyperbaric chamber. After awakening Peterson and attaching the cybernetic leg to replace the one he lost, he attempted to taunt the former S.H.I.E.L.D. agent into killing Skye but Peterson claimed those weren't his orders and left the room. Quinn then shot Skye twice in the stomach, claiming he was under orders too. No sooner than he left her that he was captured by Coulson's team. Quinn was kept imprisoned on the Bus as Coulson's team delivered Skye to a medical facility. Agent Melinda May soon assaulted Quinn, giving him a taste of what it was like to be helpless before Coulson restrained her. The Bus was later boarded by Agent John Garrett, who had been pursuing Quinn since Malta, to transfer him to the Fridge. After reaching a compromise to question Quinn on the plane, Garrett reminding Quinn that he held no rights in their custody. Quinn then admitted that he shot Skye on the Clairvoyant's orders and told Garrett that it was because of the Clairvoyant that he had always been a step ahead of S.H.I.E.L.D. He revealed that the Clairvoyant wanted to know how Coulson was resurrected, and so used Coulson's desperation to save Skye to lead them to the place of Coulson's resurrection. Later, Garrett informed Quinn that the base where Coulson was treated was destroyed, leaving nothing for the Clairvoyant to use, that his ally abandoned him and that Skye would make a fully recovery to testify against him. ian soo.origin: Ian Soo was just a young New Yorker being pushed around by his lazy and bossy girlfriend Zoe Valencia, who was part of a delinquent female gang. Once he received telekinetic powers from the Terrigen Mist cloud, he blacked out for three days and when he woke up, Zoe had packed Ian's stuff in boxes. She wanted him to leave their apartment, before going herself. At loose ends in his life, he decided to become a super-criminal and committed a robbery as the "Telekinian". He was stopped by Hellcat, who decided to help Ian turn his life around, and they became roommates.

ian wajler.name: Ian Wajler
ian wajler.origin: ===Origin=== Ian Wajler became a human cybernetic technopath after developing the very advanced remote servo-technology called Mainframe for Cybertek Systems, Inc., the applied cybernetics division owned by Roxxon Oil Corporation where he worked as a private contractor. Wajler's brain was implanted with the Mainframe technology, and he was outfitted with state-of-the-art gear, after which he adopted Mainframe as his own nom de guerre. As a contractor, Mainframe also developed and performed field tests of heavy armaments in the robotics and cybernetics department of Cybertek. thumb|right|In civilian clothes Mainframe was called when Cybertek's important venture, the super-soldier cyborg Deathlok, turned rogue and left escaped the company. Cybertek's Division Head Harlan Ryker's men tracked the fugitive weapon Deathlok to a Jesus Badalemente's home in Coney Island, near the amusement park. Ryker provided Mainframe with a team of agents equipped with Terminal Armor, Dragonfly flying vehicles and the SQ1 submarine, along with a van from which Mainframe coordinated the operation. Although Ryker wanted the public to not be aware of the operation, Mainframe staged a spectacular attack in a full-of-people amusement park, his concession to the orders being trying to kill journalists on site. However, Deathlok saved many lives and, along with Badalamente who grabbed a discarded high-tech rifle, destroyed Mainframe's weapons. After his failure, Mainframe was apprehended by the police and sent to the maximum security prison of supervillains the Vault, although Cybertek covered up their involvement. Soon afterward, however, Ryker's and Cybertek's illegal dealings were proved, and Cybertek was disbanded, with many of their assets and designs ending up in the hands of criminal organization AIM. ===Alliance with Ben Jacobs=== Mainframe spent months in the Vault, honing his skills in seizing control of the security systems in order to escape. He also contacted Ben Jacobs, a former weapons designer for Cybertek who had worked on the Deathlok project and who, like Mainframe, had been defeated and humiliated by Deathlok, to propose him an alliance. Jacobs couldn't move his legs and had only one arm, so Mainframe tempted him by offering him technology that would allow him to walk and use two hands, in exchange for Jacobs modifying the Mainframe's cybercontrol circuitry. Eventually, Mainframe escaped from prison (although Deathlok was monitoring activities related to him and his other enemies, and was informed immediately), and met with Jacobs in an abandoned Brooklyn warehouse to give Jacobs his new armor. Mainframe convinced Jacobs to control Deathlok's actions between the two of them (Mainframe provided cybercontrol technology, and Jacobs modified it so it could override Deathlok's operating system), and then rent Deathlok out for money. Jacobs temporarily agreed, making it clear that he wanted to finish off Deathlok afterwards. thumb|left|Controlling a Guardsman to escape the Vault Mainframe knew that Deathlok was hiding out at Badalemente's, who worked making props for the Coney Island amusement park. Mainframe used his powers to control an animatronics dinosaur and turn it into a threat, and later did the same with a crane, with which he attacked Deathlok without caring about collateral damage. Deathlok found Mainframe and Jacobs, and tried to go after them, but when he came within Mainframe's range, Mainframe controlled Deathlok's technology and immobilized him long enough for Jacobs to insert a disk into Deathlok that would place Deathlok under Mainframe's control. Jacobs and Mainframe then attacked AIM Research Facility #13 in Stamford, Connecticut, with Mainframe in the rear controlling Deathlok's movements, and Jacobs wearing even larger armor with heavy weaponry. Mainframe wanted to get advanced designs and technology that AIM had, and Jacobs wanted to take the opportunity to get back at AIM for a previous offense. The attack was so brutal that the authorities (police, SWAT and Army Reserve) felt overwhelmed and did not intervene. During the attack, Mainframe observed that Deathlok did not use lethal force because Deathlok's organic brain, Michael Collins, had installed a "no killing" parameter in his software; Mainframe attempted to remove it, but Collins confronted Mainframe in cyberspace to stop him, and Collins eventually prevailed, regaining control of the cyborg and ejecting the disk from his arm. Jacobs, seeing the problem, attempted to deal with Deathlok by physically destroying him, and in the process pushed Mainframe to the ground and injured his arm; meanwhile, the Army intervened, seeing that Deathlok was facing the other enemies. Mainframe however wanted to stop Jacobs from harming the cyborg because Mainframe hoped to regain control over Deathlok, but Jacobs was dominated by his thirst for revenge; therefore, Mainframe, seeing the operation ruined, controlled Jacobs' armor with his powers and forced him

fields.personality: A mercenary working for the higher bidder, Mainframe cares little for collateral damage, including innocent people who may be hurt directly during his operations He does care for his reputation and is unlikely to go back on his word: When arrested while working for Silvermane, Mainframe refused to collaborate with the authorities. He is also proud of his technological achievements and of the potential profit that could be achieved even if the item itself is immoral.
weaknesses: While muscular in appearance, Mainframe is a poor fighter. During the fight in Stamford, he was injured in his arm when his own ally Ben Jacobs carelessly pushed him.
transportation: While working for Cybertek Systems, Inc., he was provided a van to move around, as well as the SQ 1 Deep Sea Attack Craft, while on missions. Working in the Paris base, he used a hovering platform with a force field to move around.
fields.notes: In Spider-Man: Power of Terror #3, Mainframe tells Deathlok "I told you I'd control your destiny again." This seems to be a reference to Deathlok Vol. 2 #8, where Mainframe controlled Deathlok, then Deathlok recovered and Mainframe said that "I could've gotten back in!" (referring to Deathlok's operating system) - but Deathlok was not in hearing range when Mainframe said this. During the Paris operation, Mainframe did not talk directly to Deathlok.
fields.trivia: Mainframe is explicitly called "Mr. Wajler" (by his employer Ryker), meaning that Wajler does not have a PhD - otherwise, Ryker would have known and called him Dr., as with some of his other employees. Ian Wajler smokes cigarettes.

ian whippingham.name: Ian Whippingham
ian whippingham.origin: Ian was the assistant and lover of Kenneth Flogg and was first tasked to stake out the claw machine that contained the Amulet of Pazuzu and see who was the chosen of the generation. Upon finding out it was Suzi Pazuzu, Kenneth sent Ian and Dr Bong to kill her and retrieve it. However, upon entering her house, the amulet landed on Howard the Duck's wrist, transforming him and in fit of rage and gratuitous violence, Howard killed Ian.

iann 23.name: Iann-23
iann 23.origin: Huntarr was once a young man named Iann-23, subjected to Karza's experiments which made his body incredibly metamorphic. He was dispatched to attack the Micronauts on behalf of Force Commander, who Karza was possessing at the time. He almost killed Princess Mari in her attempt to reach Force Commander, but Mari sensed Huntarr's confusion and sadness and convinced him he could find peace of mind by joining the Micronauts. Huntarr travelled with them for a short time, unsure of himself as he had family on Homeworld. But after a side trip to Homeworld, and witnessing the tragic suicide of both his mother and sister, he returned to the Micronauts' welcome. Huntarr sacrificed himself along with the rest of the Micronauts in order to restore life through the Microverse. While several Micronauts have resurfaced, Huntarr has not.

iao thamungazoth.name: Iao-Thamungazoth
iao thamungazoth.origin: Iao-Thamungazoth was one of the Lords of Chaos and Lords of Darkness worshiped by the Dragon Kings of Lemuria, half a million years ago. They offered him sacrifice to feed their growing power. When the adventurers Sharjsha, Sumia Chond, and Karm Karvus came to the Castle of the Dragon Kings, on the four Dragon Isles of the inland Sea of Neol-Shendis, Sssaaa, High Priest of the Dragon Kings intended to sacrifice the three of them to the Lord of Chaos at the Altar of the Monoliths, to provide them the life-energies they required to cross the intercosmic gulfs to Earth. As the hour of the equinox came, Sssaaa was about to perform the sacrifice before the Lords of Chaos, whose faces appeared in the sky. The ceremony was interrupted by Thongor, who was soon assisted by Father Gorm who stroke down all the Dragon Kings.

iara dos santos.name: Iara Dos Santos
iara dos santos.origin: ===Early Life=== Iara dos Santos was born in a small coastal town in Brazil, her childhood spent amid the vibrant rhythms of coastal life. She was a regular Brazilian girl, with dreams as vast as the ocean that bordered her home. However, her life took an unexpected turn when she began experiencing peculiar cravings for fresh fish. As she grew, so did the intensity of these cravings, until they became overpowering urges that seemed to consume her thoughts. It wasn't long before the inexplicable happened - Iara underwent a startling transformation, her human form giving way to that of a fearsome were-shark. Caught between the tumult of adolescence and the chaos of her newfound mutant powers, Iara found herself the subject of interest of the mutant community. Among them were Angel and Mystique, who both sought to recruit her to their respective causes. Initially resistant to the overtures of both Angel and Mystique, Iara grappled with the weight of her choices. The world of mutants was as alien to her as the depths of the ocean were familiar. Despite their persuasive attempts, she remained steadfast in her refusal to align herself with either faction. However, Mystique's patience wore thin, her determination leading her to resort to force in her pursuit of Iara. Angel swooped in just in time, rescuing Iara from the clutches of Mystique's relentless pursuit. He whisked her away to safety, transporting her to the sanctuary of the Jean Grey School for Higher Learning. ===Jean Grey School for Higher Learning=== Under the compassionate guidance of the school's faculty and students, Iara found solace and purpose. Despite the distance from her coastal home in Brazil, she felt a sense of belonging within the school's walls. Eventually, she made the decision to enroll as a student, eager to learn more about her abilities and how to wield them responsibly. Balancing her education with her ties to Brazil, Iara adopted a unique arrangement, splitting her time between the school and her homeland. Weekdays were spent honing her skills and expanding her knowledge at the school, while weekends offered her the chance to return to the familiar shores of Brazil, where she could reconnect with her family she held dear. Later, she was among the students to go in the Frankenstein's Monster's Murder Circus, where she battled a mind-controlled Warbird and zombie clowns. After that adventure, Wolverine took her and other troubling students to the Savage Land, hoping they would learn to work together by being subjected to dangers they couldn't overcome alone. The excursion didn't go as Wolverine planned due to a surprise attack by his missing brother Dog Logan, but the students, with the exception of Glob, all came through and passed the special class. The months passed, and Iara began finding her place in the school, also growing more comfortable in her shark form, and rarely changing back to human. ===Age of X-Man=== Iara was one of the many mutants that opposed the crazed X-Man from remaking the world in his image. When X-Man realized that his vision of the world would never come about with the X-Men around, X-Man made his enemies vanish in an instant, including Iara. Iara and the others were transported to another plane of existence created by X-Man in an attempt at a utopia where every mutant would be at peace, altering their memories so they wouldn't resist. There, Iara was happy as a student of the Summers Institute for Higher Learning and a member of its Agricultural Division, but eventually the illusion fell apart and everyone was returned to the real world. ===Krakoa=== After returning from the Age of X-Man reality, Iara became a citizen of the mutant nation of Krakoa and she was seen celebrating when Krakoa was officially recognized as a nation. While there, she appeared to have become friends with the former Morlock Marrow, and the two even went on missions with the Dark Riders together. ===Dazzler's Band=== After the fall of Krakoa, Iara became a part of Dazzler's band. Because of strained human-mutant relations and public appearance, Wind Dancer, the band's manager, had her wear an image inducer in order to appear human-looking while performing their first show. However, it failed during Scorpia's attack on Dazzler.

iarbonel.name: Iarbonel
iarbonel.species: Forebearer of the Tuatha de Danaan
iarbonel.origin: ===Origins=== Iarbonel was a high chieftain who fathered the first generation of Tuatha de Danaan after mating with Danu, the name by which the Tuatha knew the primordial Earth Mother, Gaea. Among their children were Nuada, the Dagda, Leir, Badb, Macha, Morrigan, Ogma, and Ériu. ===Tuatha's Father=== Iarbonel and his offspring resided in Tír na nÓg, a realm within the Otherworld, while some of the Tuatha inhabited the underworld of Annwn. During their time in Tír na nÓg, his sons ruled at least two of the four great cities of the Tuatha de Danann: The Dagda governed Murias, while Nuada ruled over Finias. ===Death=== Following Iarbonel’s death, Nuada assumed leadership of the Tuatha de Danann. Around 1896 BC, the Tuatha departed their cities and traveled through an interdimensional nexus to Earth, arriving on the Irish mainland.

iba taub.origin: Colonel Faroun attempted a coup in Idnshar by kidnapping King Iba-Taub, not imagining instead that he kidnapped Bob Brant, who looked very much like Iba-Taub. iblis.name: Iblis
iblis.origin: Iblis was an angel living in Heaven. According to unconfirmed sources, Iblis became a fallen angel, cast out of Heaven, presuambly for participating in Lucifer's rebellion. She self-styled as the Mother of Djinns and Demons. During the mystical adventure of the Fantastic Four in the world of Sinbad, during their 3rd Voyage, they infiltrated her temple to acquire the Mallet of Destiny. Managing to make eye-contact with Reed Richards, Susan and Johnny Storm, turning them into demonic forms, with Reed and Sue petrified into statues. Ben Grimm and Johnny managed to expose her to sunlight (Ben tore apart the roof and held it over himself, while Johnny fused the catacombs' walls into mirrors), causing her to turn in stone while cursing the House of Sinbad.

ibrahim zaid.name: Ibrahim Zaid
ibrahim zaid.origin: Major-General Ibrahim Zaid serves as a high-ranking official within the Mossad, holding authority over international operations and field agents. During an investigation conducted in the United States, his authority is invoked to ensure Sabra maintains full operational control while tracking a suspect identified through biometric screening at John F. Kennedy International Airport. His position carries enough weight that U.S. Homeland Security personnel defer rather than interfere, allowing the investigation to proceed without delay.

ibrim hapanmyas.origin: Beben Oamat, a Djandan senator-in-exile, hired Elektra to execute the dictator Bridget Hapanmyas while she was on vacation in London. Elektra missed her chance and followed Hapanmyas back to Djanda. Elektra successfully assassinated Hapanmyas, her son Ibrim, security chief, and single-handedly helped the local rebels overthrow the palace.

icarus.name: Icarus
icarus.origin: The Eternal Ikaris once went by a different name. He had been married to a human woman from ancient Minos, Crete. He named his son Icarus or Ikaris. The boy was given high tech wings fashioned by Phastos and Makkari, and his father intended to teach him how to use them but for years he was absent due to fighting with the Deviants. The son became impatient and wore the wings in a bid to find his father. He flew too high and lost consciousness due to lack of air. The father found the boy's body in time and chose to honor his son by taking his name. With the father being immortal, the son's name Ikaris would live on forever. The tale fell into legend becoming part of Greek mythology, the tale changed to Icarus ignoring his father's instructions not to fly too close to the sun; his wings melted and he fell the the ground, sparking the idiom "don't fly too close to the sun."

ice king.name: Ice King
ice king.origin: The origins of the Ice King are unknown; he lives in a secret cavern beneath Antarctica, somewhere near the location of Antarctic Atlantis. He claims that he can only reveal himself to one mortal being every ten years before going into seclusion. He was first discovered in the mid-1920s by a young Sub-Mariner who was exploring around his home. The Ice King claimed that he and Namor were friends, and that he had aided the young boy in the past, and Namor had aided him, although Namor was not aware of his existence or how the Ice King came to save him. After their initial encounter, Namor returned to his people and tried to tell his fellow Atlanteans about the Ice King, but the young prince's claims were shrugged off and laughed at. When herds of seals, which the Atlanteans relied on for survival, began to vanish, Namor sought the Ice King's aid. The Ice King secretly assisted Namor in pushing icebergs around the ice sheet where the seals where located, preventing them from swimming out of the area. When the young Sub-Mariner told his people that the Ice King helped him, he was once more laughed off. Furious, Namor went to the Ice King and asked him to reveal himself to the Atlanteans. However, the Ice King declined, telling Namor about how he can only reveal himself to a single mortal once every ten years. The Ice King then wished Namor the best, telling the boy that they will likely never see each other ever again. As Namor left the Ice King's lair, an earthquake struck, sealing the tunnel. The Ice King has not been seen since. His current status is unknown.

ice princess.name: Ice Princess
ice princess.origin: Ice Princess is of Inuit heritage. She was first seen aboard the S. S. Superia, and participated in the assault on Captain America and Paladin. Later, when Paladin and the Asp rescued Diamondback, they were confronted by the Ice Princess, alongside Ferocia, the Iron Maiden, and Whiteout. Diamondback used one of Ice Princess's ice spikes to stab Ferocia and stop her from mauling the Asp. The four Femizons were defeated and the others stole their costumes to sneak off the island unmolested. She appeared years later, attempting to take over upper Manhattan alongside Wrangler but was captured by Speedball, Hazmat, and Mettle.

iceberg.name: Iceberg
iceberg.origin: ===Liberteens=== Iceberg was a member of the Liberteens, the Pennsylvanian team of the 50-state Initiative. He was inspired by Jack Frost. He was with the Liberteens when they saved the Liberty Bell from Flag-Smasher and Ultimatum terrorists. Iceberg and his fellow Liberteens 2-D, Hope, and Ms. America later left the Liberteens and formed their own team called the Fantastix to replace the disbanded Fantastic Four. They were also able to gain ownership of the Baxter Building. The Fantastix's first mission was stopping the Wrecking Crew from robbing a jewelry store that just across the street from the Baxter Building. The real Fantastic Four later showed up and revealed that the robbery was actually staged by the Fantastix's manager and publicist Brenda Bannicheck in order to boost the team's popularity. Iceberg and his team then got the blessing of the Fantastic Four to continue using the Baxter Building. The Fantastix saw little action during their subsequent career, mostly due to being stand-ins for the Fantastic Four with the Fantastic Four being around. When the powerful alien Cormorant scoured the Earth in search for a mysterious artifact, he unceremoniously destroyed the entirety of the Baxter Building to unearth Container Zero. When the Fantastic Four, Doctor Doom and Victorious arrived to confront the Cormorant, the Fantastix joined the fight. After the destruction of Container Zero ended with the creation of the Forever Gate and the Cormorant left, Mister Fantastic decided to reclaim what was left of the Baxter Building so his team could guard the portal. Despite being offered to help carry this duty, the Fantastix decided to leave it all to the Fantastic Four.

iceman.name: Iceman
iceman.origin: ===Early Life=== Robert "Bobby" Drake was born in Floral Park, Hempstead, New York as the son of William Drake and Madeline Beatrice Bass-Drake. Bobby was Jewish on his mother's side and Irish Catholic on his father's. The family lived in Fort Washington, Long Island. As an infant, young Bobby looked up to his parents and thought very highly of them. He grew to love the beach. An imaginative young boy, he was told by his father that dreamers never got anywhere in life. Bobby developed shame toward his imagination, something that would limit him for years to come. At the age of ten, Bobby broke his arm, only for his stern father to tell him to stop crying. By the time Bobby entered adolescence, he began to feel cold all the time, an early manifestation of his mutant powers. ===Becoming Iceman=== thumb|left|Young Bobby Drake Bobby's mutant powers manifested themselves for the first time when he froze the water in the family swimming pool. His parents quickly realized that their son was a mutant, and warned him to be careful about his powers because others would grow to fear them. Bobby began secretly practicing the use of his powers and quickly learned how to coat his body in snow, he found the idea of being a mutant to be an amazing experience. In school, Drake began dating Judy Harmon, earning the ire of local bully Rocky Beasely. In his free time, Bobby continued practicing how to use his mutant powers to freeze the moisture in the air. One day he asked Judy out on a date to the movies. After the show was over they were harassed by Rocky and his gang. When Bobby feared for Judy's safety, he used his mutant powers to freeze Rocky in a block of ice. Horrified by what happened, the gang and Judy fled the scene. Bobby then rushed home to his parents to tell them what had happened. Not long after, the local sheriff came by to take Bobby into police custody. Believing that he would get a fair trial, Bobby surrendered to the police. When the story made the news, it was read by Professor Charles Xavier, a mutant telepath, who was gathering a group of mutants to train to help in his quest to bring peaceful co-existence between humans and mutants. Xavier sent his first student, Cyclops to go to Bobby and invite him to join his group, the X-Men. Cyclops broke into Bobby's prison cell and offered to help him escape. Bobby refused, wanting to have his day in court, and the two came to blows. Their fight took them across town, attracting the attention of the locals who formed a lynch mob to kill Bobby. Before the mob could execute Cyclops and Bobby, Professor Xavier intervened, using his mental powers to erase the memories of Bobby's mutant powers from the whole town. Xavier then offered Bobby a chance to join his School for Gifted Youngsters and become a member of the X-Men, an offer that Bobby accepted and was given the codename Iceman. Upon arriving at Xavier's school in Westchester County, the first thing Bobby did was ice up and use his powers, happy to finally be somewhere they he could be himself. ===Joining the X-Men=== Xavier next became aware of Warren Worthington III, a mutant who had wings enabling him to fly. Tracking Angel down, Xavier sent both Cyclops and Iceman to recruit him just after the Avenging Angel succeeded in recovering a stolen vial of a radioactive isotope. However the isotope had an effect on the Angel's mind, and he battled the two X-Men. His sanity restored, Warren also agreed to join the X-Men. Soon Charles began reading about Duffee, Illinois high school football star Henry McCoy whose enhanced agility and large hands and feet identified him as a mutant. However, Hank's abilities also attracted the attention of the terrorist known as the Conquistador who sought to utilize those powers for his goals of conquering the world. Xavier sent his X-Men to rescue Hank and his family from the Conquistador's lair. Like the others, Hank agreed to transfer to Xavier's school and join the X-Men taking the code name Beast. With telekinetic Jean Grey joining the group, Xavier's team of X-Men was complete. He began training them to hone their powers in his specially constructed Danger Room. Iceman was a goofy and clownish presence within the X-Men as its youngest member, constantly causing trouble with his teammates Angel and Beast due to his immaturity. Still, his lighthearted approach to disaster often eased tension among his friends. ===Early Missions=== thumb|left|The original X-Men: Marvel Girl, Angel, Beast, Cyclops, Iceman. The threat of the mutant terrorist Magneto forced Xavier to call upon his X-Men to prepare for their first battle against his one-time friend. Through Xavier's guidance, Iceman and the X-Men succeeded in stopping Magneto from taking over the Cape Citadel missile base, forcing the master of magnetism to flee. Later, during an early training session Scott bested Iceman in combat. Bobby, a natural prankster, reciprocated by using his ice powers to play various pranks on Scott unti

At the age of ten, Bobby broke his arm, only for his stern father to tell him to stop crying. By the time Bobby entered adolescence, he began to feel cold all the time, an early manifestation of his mutant powers. ===Becoming Iceman=== thumb|left|Young Bobby Drake Bobby's mutant powers manifested themselves for the first time when he froze the water in the family swimming pool. His parents quickly realized that their son was a mutant, and warned him to be careful about his powers because others would grow to fear them. Bobby began secretly practicing the use of his powers and quickly learned how to coat his body in snow, he found the idea of being a mutant to be an amazing experience. In school, Drake began dating Judy Harmon, earning the ire of local bully Rocky Beasely. In his free time, Bobby continued practicing how to use his mutant powers to freeze the moisture in the air. One day he asked Judy out on a date to the movies. After the show was over they were harassed by Rocky and his gang. When Bobby feared for Judy's safety, he used his mutant powers to freeze Rocky in a block of ice. Horrified by what happened, the gang and Judy fled the scene. Bobby then rushed home to his parents to tell them what had happened. Not long after, the local sheriff came by to take Bobby into police custody. Believing that he would get a fair trial, Bobby surrendered to the police. When the story made the news, it was read by Professor Charles Xavier, a mutant telepath, who was gathering a group of mutants to train to help in his quest to bring peaceful co-existence between humans and mutants. Xavier sent his first student, Cyclops to go to Bobby and invite him to join his group, the X-Men. Cyclops broke into Bobby's prison cell and offered to help him escape. Bobby refused, wanting to have his day in court, and the two came to blows. Their fight took them across town, attracting the attention of the locals who formed a lynch mob to kill Bobby. Before the mob could execute Cyclops and Bobby, Professor Xavier intervened, using his mental powers to erase the memories of Bobby's mutant powers from the whole town. Xavier then offered Bobby a chance to join his School for Gifted Youngsters and become a member of the X-Men, an offer that Bobby accepted and was given the codename Iceman. Upon arriving at Xavier's school in Westchester County, the first thing Bobby did was ice up and use his powers, happy to finally be somewhere they he could be himself. ===Joining the X-Men=== Xavier next became aware of Warren Worthington III, a mutant who had wings enabling him to fly. Tracking Angel down, Xavier sent both Cyclops and Iceman to recruit him just after the Avenging Angel succeeded in recovering a stolen vial of a radioactive isotope. However the isotope had an effect on the Angel's mind, and he battled the two X-Men. His sanity restored, Warren also agreed to join the X-Men. Soon Charles began reading about Duffee, Illinois high school football star Henry McCoy whose enhanced agility and large hands and feet identified him as a mutant. However, Hank's abilities also attracted the attention of the terrorist known as the Conquistador who sought to utilize those powers for his goals of conquering the world. Xavier sent his X-Men to rescue Hank and his family from the Conquistador's lair. Like the others, Hank agreed to transfer to Xavier's school and join the X-Men taking the code name Beast. With telekinetic Jean Grey joining the group, Xavier's team of X-Men was complete. He began training them to hone their powers in his specially constructed Danger Room. Iceman was a goofy and clownish presence within the X-Men as its youngest member, constantly causing trouble with his teammates Angel and Beast due to his immaturity. Still, his lighthearted approach to disaster often eased tension among his friends. ===Early Missions=== thumb|left|The original X-Men: Marvel Girl, Angel, Beast, Cyclops, Iceman. The threat of the mutant terrorist Magneto forced Xavier to call upon his X-Men to prepare for their first battle against his one-time friend. Through Xavier's guidance, Iceman and the X-Men succeeded in stopping Magneto from taking over the Cape Citadel missile base, forcing the master of magnetism to flee. Later, during an early training session Scott bested Iceman in combat. Bobby, a natural prankster, reciprocated by using his ice powers to play various pranks on Scott unti

fields.notes: lists some different historical information on Bobby Drake. His birthplace is listed as Floral Park, New York; And his father's name is noted as 'Robert N.' Drake. At the time Drake was a student at Dartmouth College. The change of Iceman's ice form from being smooth to having spikes was conceived by Scott Lobdell. When Lobdell asked Uncanny X-Men editor Bob Harras permission to alter Iceman's appearance, he was turned down, due to an Iceman action figure having been just released by ToyBiz at the time, arguing the licensor wouldn't be okay with the character looking differently in the comics than he did in the toy. Lobdell got around to changing Iceman's appearance, albeit temporarily, when the character was taken over by Emma Frost in . As it turned out, the marketing division came up to Lobdell and asked him to use the spiked design for an action figure, which led to Iceman having spikes in his ice form becoming a long-term change. It is currently unknown if Iceman suppressed his secondary mutation along with his powers or if, like Black Tom Cassidy, he lost his secondary mutation and kept his primary mutation after M-Day.
fields.trivia: Most of Iceman's more creative uses for his powers were done by Emma Frost inside Iceman's body and have yet to actually be done by Iceman himself. Cyclops was the one who suggested that Bobby focus on "refining his ice crystals," making his ice-form less like a snowman and more like a living transparent being of ice. Iceman has at times expressed reluctance to "unfrost" himself, and a preference for his ice-form even when not needed for missions. Iceman has feared that he could be killed by Cyclops' blasts, if his teammate poorly aimed them. Bobby thinks his teammate Angel is hot. Iceman was one of the characters featured in the series of Marvel Value Stamps issued in the 1970s.

ichabod.name: Ichabod
ichabod.origin: Ichabod was the horse ridden by Matthew Masters, a doctor during the days of the American Frontier. Masters was previously a youthful outlaw known as the Cactus Kid. He was convinced by the Governor of Texas to swear off violence and killing to study and become a doctor. At sometime during his adult years, Matthews purchased Ichabod who was more or less a tame horse. However, when Masters developed the masked identity of the Black Rider, a heroic gunfighter devoted to fighting lawlessness in the west, he took to riding Ichabod -- calling him Satan during his adventures -- and the horse would prove to be as daring and gallant as his master when he was masquerading as the Black Rider. For the most part, either as Ichabod or Satan, the horse usually rode Matthew Masters or his alter ego the Black Rider around the region. However, the highly intelligent horse often helped the Black Rider during some of his adventures. Such as when Masters came across horse rustler Brush Bennett trying to steal the Lathrop's cattle. Matthew was grazed across the brow with a bullet, knocking him out and Satan rode him safety. Later when Bennett had captured the Black Rider, Satan came to his master's rescue, trampling Bennett to death. Later, when outlaw Tod Sultan briefly posed as the Black Rider, he attempted to use Satan to escape from Matthew Masters. Instead of riding away with the impostor, Satan bucket the outlaw off his back sending him falling off a cliff to his death. Satan more frequently came to his master's aid, saving him from trouble such as when both the Black Rider and Marie Lathrop found themselves prisoner of the mad scientist Professor Chalis, Satan chewed through their bonds so that they could escape. When they were attacked by Chalis' assistant, a giant named Zugg, Satan killed him with a blow to the head. Later, while the Black Rider was investigating a human smuggling operation that brought illegal Mexican immigrants into the United States, the ringleader Senior Morales got the drop on the Black Rider. However, the villain made the mistake of trying to mount Satan who simply bucked Morales off his back, sending the smuggler falling down a cliff to his death. When the Black Rider was assisting in the hunt for a puma that was stalking the Lathrop ranch, he shot the big cat before it could attack Marie. When the wounded beast tried to attack again, it met its end under Satan's trampling hooves. When the Black Rider exposed Marie's cousin Oscar Tippitt as the mastermind behind a bank robbery, the hero found himself locked in a hotel room while Tippitt attempted to flee town. Satan came to his master's aid by kicking down the door and the pair caught up with Tippitt as Matthew Masters and Ichabod and apprehended him. Eventually, the Black Rider moved on from Leadville, becoming a frontier doctor taking Satan with him. Satan took Masters to such places as: La Muerto, New Mexico; Edgeville; Gladwin Junction; Pass of the Needle; Brimstone City; Brimstone desert; Aspen Creek; Yellow Bluff; Hot Strike, Nevada; Crippled Bend, Colorado; Tombstone; Fort Noble, Montana; Locus Glen; Flat City, Wyoming; and Hope City. However, faithful as ever Ichabod accompanied his master when he eventually returned to Leadville to resume his practice there. But Ichabod/Satan still took his master to such locations as Santo Del Oro, Mexico; Doom Road; San Juan; Bedlam; El Dorado; Sonora, Mexico; Mule Messa; and Los Pintos.

ichabod rasputin.name: Ichabod Rasputin
ichabod rasputin.origin: Angered at the world which mocked magic and the occult practices that he loved, Ichabod Rasputin used the magic of the Tavistick and animated the gigantic statue Fangor in New York City. Unfortunately, he was unable to control Fangor and he ran amok. Iron Man battled and defeated Fangor. In the ensuing battle the Tavistick was destroyed. Dejected, and despite some kind words from Dr. Strange on his belief in magic, Rasputin appeared to abandon his work in the occult.

ichiro hazaki.name: Ichiro Hazaki
ichiro hazaki.origin: Ichiro Hazaki, better known as the Bonsai Master, was an influential Japanese political figure. He sought to control the future of Japan for backing both leading candidates for the post of the Prime Minister, Itaru Ozu and Shinji Yokohama, while keeping the secret from both of them. Shinji asked the Bonsai Master to get rid of his candidate Ken Takahara, whose platform was too progress and threatened the traditional ways. The Bonsai Master hired the Rooster of the Yakuza to arrange the hit and tasked General Kato with gettind rid of the hitman at the same time. The men send by the General were eventually found dead, as was another group send in their wake. Panicking about his own fate, Kato went to talk to the Bonsai Master, who assured him that the situation was under control. On the night of the election, the Bonsai Master was targeted by Hit-Monkey. The Monkey went through the Bonsai Master's security forces before eventually confronting him in a katana duel. The Bonsai Master managed to inflict several surface wounds, but the Monkey ended up beating him. Shamed by defeat, the Bonsai Master committed seppuku.

ichisumi.name: Ichisumi
ichisumi.origin: ===Early Life=== thumb|left Ichisumi was born around 1833 AD in Kumamoto, Japan. Ichisumi was the daughter of a proud samurai, and constantly disappointed her father in her occupation of a geisha by never getting chosen by any wealthy men. This led to Ichisumi later suffering from an acute inferiority complex; upon the manifestation of her mutant power, she had her Yume beetles attack all of the other geisha she believed to be prettier. The beetles went through hundreds of women until they returned to her; when they did, she was unaware, or did not care, that she would mentally link with them, and the mutilation of the beetles drove her mad. ===Final Horseman=== Ichisumi was watched by the eternal mutant Apocalypse and selected as his Final Horseman Pestilence in the event that all other plans of Apocalypse failed. Zak-Del kidnapped him from Rocket's ship and took him to another ship. Zak-Del's ship was caught by another Rocket ship and Pike escaped from Zak-Del's ship. Rocket tried to capture him and accidentally destroyed his own ship. Rocket teleported the Nova Corps building into space and Pike was eventually arrested.

ideal.name: Ideal
ideal.origin: The Ideal was part of a group called the Adaptoids, a strike force who act on behalf of the Descendants, the robot people of the Core, led by the ominous Father. However, the Ideal also maintained a human identity as "Dr Leivan", a doctor in New York City. The Adaptoids were deployed to rescue Yalda, a Pakistani woman with Descendant heritage. Father and the Adaptoids raided A.I.M. Island in order to liberate a Stark Sentinel from A.I.M.. Just as they succeeded in their plan, they were confronted by the Avengers who also came there to take the Sentinel since it had secret files on every superheroes strengths and weaknesses. thumb|left|250px|The Ideal vs Captain America This led to a battle between the two groups with the Ideal targeting Captain America, after the latter through his shield at Ideal's teammate The Swine to knock him off balance. Ideal kept Cap at bay by smashing his fists against the shield. After gaining the upper hand. The Idea's body was suddenly shut down from an neural inhibitor created by Giant-Man in order to stop them in their tracks, but was considered by Vision as the equivalent of killing them.

idi amin.name: Idi Amin
idi amin.origin: ===Preface=== The past history of Idi Amin of Earth-616 likely mirrors that of his . The purpose of this article is to document activities that a unique to the Earth-616 universe. Appearances of Amin in the Modern Age should be considered topical references per the Sliding Timescale of Earth-616. Idi Amin was president of Uganda from 1971 to 1979 and was infamous for his various human rights violations, political repression, ethnic persecution, among other crimes. His attempts to annex the Kagera province of Tanzania in 1978 led to the . The conflict was an utter failure to Amin who then fled to Libya where he remained in exile until his death in 2003. ===Apocryphal Appearances=== Amin was depicted as the President of Uganda when Kinji Obatu convinced the president that he could raise Uganda's profile on the world stage by kidnapping prominent African-Americans and forcing them to live in his country. Utilizing the skills of voodoo practitioner W'Sulli, Obatu made good his promise and also managed to kidnap the Black Panther as well. Obatu took his prisoners to Amin's government residence in Kampala, and Amin received him open-armed, also witnessing a voodoo ceremony where W'Sulli took over the prisoners' minds. This plot was thwarted by the combined efforts of the Thing and Brother Voodoo, who sneaked into Uganda; fearing for his own safety, Amin drove away, leaving Obatu and W'Sulli behind. Both Obatu and W'Sulli were killed by their own agent, Nightspawn; and afterward the heroes left with their prisoners, believing that not even Amin would dare to attract attention to the Thing entering his country, because he'd also have to explain about the men Obatu had kidnapped from the United States.

fields.notes: thumb|left|Idi Amin (upper left) is hinted to be a demon. This is a fictionalized version of , a real historical figure. Idi Amin's face was shown in the art of while Belathauzer explained how members of his demonic race already roam Earth disguised as humans in order to sow discord and create chaos, implying that Idi Amin is secretly a demon. It is unclear if this is actually the case. , Tanzania's profile, mentions how Uganda tried to annex the Kagera province of Tanzania and this led to a war. It does not mention explicitly Amin's involvement or the consequences for him. In , Obatu addresses Amin as "Sir". This is not the appropriate protocol; Amin was to be addressed as "His Excellency". It's unlikely for Obatu to make that blunder: Having been a Minister under Amin, Obatu is expected to know these details. On a related note, in , Obatu ambitions the position of Prime Minister of his country (then unspecified, but later be stated as Uganda in ); and in Marvel Two-In-One #41, Amin is identified as the Prime Minister of Uganda. However, the position of Prime Minister had been abolished from 1966 to 1980, during Amin's dictatorship. Amin was not Prime Minister, but President for Life (as well as a number of other titles, none of them being Prime Minister). (2004), in two appendix entries (Nightspawn and Kinji Obatu), initially retcons the events told in (1978), where part of the plot takes place in Uganda and features historical then-President Idi Amin. Due to the Sliding Timescale, Amin's appearance should be consider a Topical Reference, as Amin historically was deposed in 1979 and died in 2003. The Encyclopedia instad replaces Amin with fictional African dictator Eda Arul and Uganda with fictional country Imaya (both seen mainly in ). However, later sources have disregarded this retcon and instead modified the continuity again so that the events in Marvel Two-In-One #41 take place in Uganda, only with an unnamed ruler instead of Amin. Specifically: Brother Voodoo's profile in both (2005) and (2008) both mention Obatu's escape to "a small African nation bordering Uganda", as had been stated in Marvel Two-In-One #41 because he escaped from Uganda. Imaya, per , borders only Niger and Nigeria. The Squadron Sinister's profile in (2006) and (2009) do not specify Obatu's country, just stating "his native country". Doctor Spectrum's profile in (2011) explicitly states that Obutu was deported to Uganda, and also that Uganda is his native country. References to the Ugandan president's name were omitted, just saying "the Ugandan president".
fields.trivia: Obatu was wary of Amin, thinking Amin was unpredictable and erratic. W'Sulli reassured Obatu, believing that this was merely Amin's public persona. Still, Obatu had met Amin in person, while W'Sulli had not.

idie okonkwo.name: Idie Okonkwo
idie okonkwo.origin: ===The Five Lights=== 275px|thumb|right|Afflicted by cursed powers Idie Okonkwo was born into the Igbo ethnic group and lived in a Catholic village of Delta State, Nigeria. As a teenager, her mutant capacities activated near Oyo City, part of the emergence of five mutants after the decimation due to the coming of the messiah Hope. The X-Men detected the manifestation with the technology of Cerebra. Okonkwo's abilities developed erratically, causing her to burn her village down by redirecting heat. The people of her community immediately fled, abandoning her and making her feel like a vile monstrosity. A paramilitary group began hunting Okonkwo down as she desperately hid in a chapel for praying. They murdered her family and friends, accusing her of being a witch. Some of her aggressors were frozen in their attempt to execute her. The prominent member of the X-Men, Storm, arrived on the scene to incapacitate the troops and prevent them from harming Okonkwo. In this occasion, the frightened child came into contact with Hope, who stabilized her powers, forming an immediate connection between the two. In control of her abilities, Okonkwo unleashed flames to scare her aggressors off. thumb|left|200px|Seeing herself as a monster Having no living family left, Okonkwo joined Hope and other recently awoken mutants, who were dubbed the Lights. Under the guidance of Rogue, the Lights traveled around the planet to assist other young mutants. Okonkwo was particularly conflicted with accepting her condition as a mutant as something positive, but at the same time was astonished by the opportunity of getting to know the world. Their final destination was Tokyo, where the last Light was to be found. Okonkwo soon realized herself and her fellow colleagues struggled with their traumas. At the headquarters of the X-Men, the island of Utopia, she was diagnosed by Doctor Nemesis to be in perfect health condition, much to her confusion. She also quietly submitted to the X-Men's training classes. When faced with the proposition of adopting a mutant codename, Okonkwo chose to name herself Oya, after the Yoruba goddess of magic. Her decision was purposedly heretic since she wished to embrace the idea of blasphemy that came with her perception of being a monster. ===Schism=== 250px|thumb|right|Becoming a murderer Many nations of the world directed their efforts to combat mutantkind following a terrorist psychic attack performed by Quentin Quire. The incident had been orchestrated by the new Hellfire Club, a band of wealthy children who wished to profit from mutant hate by commercializing Sentinels. In response to their popularity being ruined, the X-Men celebrated the inauguration of the Museum of Mutant History in San Francisco. Since Okonkwo demonstrated she agreed with how Sentinels were deployed to massacre mutants, her colleagues, specially Laurie Tromette, took her to the opening event. Counting with the surprise factor, the Hellfire Club subdued the X-Men and prepared a bombing. Okonkwo was able to evade their attack and hide from the villains. The leader of the X-Men Cyclops psychically suggested Okonkwo to neutralize the threat, while Wolverine opposed to the plan, demanding her to lay low until he arrived. Considering herself capable of endind the terrorists, Idie Okonkwo incinerated the Hellfire Club agents to death. thumb|left|200px|A student at the Jean Grey School Thanks to Okonkwo's intervention, no innocents were harmed. She believed that murder represented what being an X-Men meant. This decision led to a philosophical schism between the X-Men. Wolverine vocally objected to how Cyclops treated the young mutants under his tutelage as soldiers. The two X-Men brutally attacked each other as the Hellfire Club attempted to destroy Utopia. The mutant youngsters prevented a catastrophic result. Following the crisis, Wolverine chose to leave Cyclops, Utopia, and the X-Men. In Westchester, he rebuilt the institute the X-Men used to live in. With Cyclops' blessing, Okonkwo was separated from the other Lights and enrolled at the new Jean Grey School for Higher Learning, despite Hope's initial objection. As a student of the Jean Grey School, Okonkwo proved to be brilliantly dedicated, despite her discomfort regarding her status as a mutant. The Hellfire Club regarded the school as a threat to their business and attempted to prevent its reopening. During their attack, Okonkwo met and befriended the young alien Broo, who challenged his brutal nature by acting with kindness. She also got to known Quentin Quire, who was forced by Wolverine into the school to reform himself. Both boys showed to be infatuated with Okonkwo. As the weeks went by, she proved to be a splendid model student in the school and began liking her new home. ===Hellfire Academy=== thumb|right|150px|Witchburning Under the radar, the Hellfire Club established themselves in Westchester. In order to manipulate Okonkwo, they used a robot built by the young Dr. Franken

fields.history: ===The Five Lights=== 275px|thumb|right|Afflicted by cursed powers Idie Okonkwo was born into the Igbo ethnic group and lived in a Catholic village of Delta State, Nigeria. The X-Men detected the manifestation with the technology of Cerebra. Okonkwo's abilities developed erratically, causing her to burn her village down by redirecting heat. The people of her community immediately fled, abandoning her and making her feel like a vile monstrosity. A paramilitary group began hunting Okonkwo down as she desperately hid in a chapel for praying. They murdered her family and friends, accusing her of being a witch. Some of her aggressors were frozen in their attempt to execute her. The prominent member of the X-Men, Storm, arrived on the scene to incapacitate the troops and prevent them from harming Okonkwo. In this occasion, the frightened child came into contact with Hope, who stabilized her powers, forming an immediate connection between the two. In control of her abilities, Okonkwo unleashed flames to scare her aggressors off. thumb|left|200px|Seeing herself as a monster Having no living family left, Okonkwo joined Hope and other recently awoken mutants, who were dubbed the Lights. fields.notes: As the youngest of the Five Lights, Okonkwo's exact age was inconsistently portrayed. In her original appearance, she was said to be twelve years old, though short time later she was stated to be fourteen years old.
fields.trivia: The name "Oya" ([ˈɔɪ.ɑː] ~ [ˈɑː.jɑː] OY-ah ~ AW-yah) refers to the Yoruba language word "Ọya", pronounced as [ɔ̄.jā], naming an orisha worshipped in Yoruba religion and other derivations. Okonkwo heretically chose this name since she is not Yoruba, but a Catholic from the . Her decision addresses how traditional African religions are commonly interpreted by fundamentalist Christians as evil; considering mutants to be damned creatures, she adopted the name as penance. The name "Temper" refers to the tempering process through which materials are hardened using intense heat and cold. Okonkwo chose this alias to represent how she will not be burned by fire or ice, but only made stronger. Creators Matt Fraction and Kieron Gillen loosely based the Five Lights mutant powers on the the archetypal power-sets on the original five X-Men. Okonkwo's temperature-based abilities echo those of Iceman. After months of cover art and promotional art depicting her hair in different styles, Okonkwo's hair was changed from a tight braided style into an afro in .

idol yimshan.name: Idol (Yimshan)
idol yimshan.origin: Having been sent by a Messantian collector, Conan of Cimmeria fought fiercely against the Acolytes of Yimsha to obtain the Idol, hiding it beneath a cloth as he took it aboard a merchant ship. Unfortunately, Thoth-Amon became aware of the idol, and sent Black Corsairs to raid the merchant ship and retrieve it. Conan fought valiantly against the pirates but, when a pirate's blood reached the idol, it suddenly transformed, killing all on the ship but for Conan himself. Conan eventually killed the beast, causing it to burst into flames, almost destroying the ship it was on.

idomeneus.name: Idomeneus
idomeneus.origin: ===Early years=== Idomeneus was the warrior-king of Crete. He was one of the many suitors of Helen, and so was bound to an oath of loyalty towards Menelaus, whom Helen had chosen for husband. Idomeneus possibly had a son, Orsilochus, though Orsilochus might be a made-up person created by Odysseus. ===Trojan War=== Therefore, he joined the Trojan War when Paris, son of Priam, king of Troy stole Helen. He battled the Amazons of Penthesileia, killing Bremusa. When Odysseus and Ajax both claimed the armor of fallen Achilles, offered by his mother Thetis to the one that had retrieved his body, Ajax proposed to let Agamemnon, Nestor and Idomeneus judge. As Nestor highlighted that the loser would be wrathful towards the judge, Agamemnon gave the task to high-born Trojan prisoners, who designated Odysseus as the winner.

idunn.origin: ===Origin=== Idunn was a Vanir, {{r|Al Ewing's tweet about Idunn [ ] }} the Goddess of Immortality, and the sister of Frey. At some point, she married Bragi. ===Keeper of the Golden Apples=== Odin appointed Idunn the Keeper of the Golden Apples, whose mystical properties retard aging among the Asgardians. She has been at times noted as the only Asgardian who can pick them from the World Tree. Once, while delivering the apples to Odin, she was attacked by the Fenris Wolf disguised as a human, but saved by Haakun the Hunter. At some point, the warrior Hoder, drunk, came to her and raped her. In revenge, Idunn denied him the apples since, causing him to live in perpetual winter. Although, she still had love for him. At another point, a couple of Storm Giants stole the Golden Apples, but Thor and Loki Laufeyson were able to retrieve them, escaping on the back of Agnar, King of the Eagles, formerly prisoner of those Giants. Yet at another point, Agnar, now the Half-King of Eagles and in a colossus form, had the Aerie Legion attack Idunn while she was harvesting her Golden Apples. She was captured along with her protectress Sif, but both were soon rescued by Thor and Loki who defeated Agnar. Odin once promised Idunn to Fasolt and Fafnir, a pair of Storm Giants, if they helped rebuild Valhalla. He did so because Loki promised Odin would not have to fulfill that promise, but Loki, it seems, was a liar. Thor (at first helped by Idunn's brother Frey) eventually deterred the giants by providing them a legendary article of gold instead. While leading an army against Odin, Loki and Tyr attacked and destroyed Idunn's home, captured her and stole the Apples for them, using some to buy the Midgard Serpent's loyalty. Idunn was then brought in front of Odin as an hostage. Caged, she was soon rescued by Balder and the Warriors Three, and brought back to Odin's palace. ===Balder's Death=== Loki used her appearance to approach Hoder, in his plot to kill Balder, promising him the apples again if he hit the God of Light with a mistletoe branch. Idunn cared for Hoder, and after his death made the preparation for his funeral and had him buried with honor, in defiance of Odin's wishes. She was later in the underwater Aegir's Hall, where the Gods drank and discussed of the incoming Ragnarök presaged by Balder's death. When Loki came, he revealed that Idunn had transgressed Odin's orders, and tried to put Idunn in accusation, but was thwarted by Sif who suspected Loki's machinations. ===Lost Gods=== When the Aesir was dispatched on Midgard on human forms as the Lost Gods, Idunn existed as Ida, a woman allegedly living with her brother Mr. Freystein (Frey) in a little condo in north Miami until they got the "travel bug" and became tourists travelling aboard a camping car, eventually meeting with other Lost Gods at the Bryce Canyon National Park in Utah. At some point after Ragnarök, she formed a triad of goddesses with Gaea and Freyja. ===All-Mother=== Following the disaster of The Serpent's attack on Asgard and the death of Thor, Odin summoned the All-Mother to assume control in his absence, choosing to abdicate from his position. During Thor's funeral, Idunn and her sisters appeared, causing the admiration from visitors of the Nine Worlds came to pay tribute to the Odinson and astonished by their return. They all soon witnessed the rebirth of "Tanarus, God of Thunder". ====Asgardia and the Congress of Worlds==== They were reported by Heimdall Odin's actions, that he had taken the Serpent's body, cast out all Asgardians from the Realm and sealed it, leaving the All-Mother in charge of Fallen Asgard. They then presented themselves to the citizens of the Nine Worlds living in Fallen Asgard, and presented them with their project of Asgardia, the capital of a republic constituted of the Nine Worlds. Idunn reported her defiance, mentioning unrest and uncertainty. The Congress of Worlds soon assembled. Quickly, the Frost Giants of Jotunheim (in fact assassins) denounced an Asgardian dominion upon a false republic and attacked the All-Mother who easily defeated them. The Congress assembled once gain, with Idunn representing Asgard. Among their first actions, on Loki's request, they lifted the curse upon Hela, who was granted the right to return to the true Hel, part of Mephisto's Realm for a time. Idunn kept collecting the Apples in the garden on east side of the Hall of Valhalla. When Vali Halfling stole them from the Tree in a plot to become a god, he tricked Amadeus Cho into going there as well. Discovering the tree fruitless, he was witnessed by Idunn, causing the arrival of Thor. At that point, Idunn revealed to Loki that she knew he had released Surtur from Limbo , forcing him to reveal the plots he had orchestrated against Odin and the Serpent, and causing him to fall under their secret service, blackmailing him by threatening to reveal the Surtur episode. The All-Mother later organized the feast of Yule, the winter solstice celebrati

fields.notes: While she has been at times noted as the only Asgardian who can pick Golden Apples from the World Tree, it seems like other beings have been able to do it as well, such as Vali Halfling.
fields.trivia: The story of how Idunn was attacked by the Fenris wolf would serve as one of the inspirations for the tale of . In Norse Mythology sources, Iðunn is the Goddess of Youth and Spring and the wife of Bragi. Also, she doesn't have Freyr as a brother. Mythology Iðunn isn't a Vanir like in Marvel, but an Asynjur, Norse goddesses who are part of the group of the Æsir Gods.
